revision.text: [[File:Wild wood whisky.png|thumb|right|The effects of [[Bottle of wild wood whisky|wild wood whisky]], from a crate in the [[Hosidian Sea]] of the [[Western Ocean]].]] This page displays all experience rewards from completely [[Sea charting|charting]] seas and oceans. Tasks are also grouped by ocean, and seas can be manually marked as finished at the bottom of this page. ==Charting experience== Charting rewards various amounts of [[Sailing]] experience, with significant bonus experience for completing every charting task in any given sea or ocean. Furthermore, full completion of all 358 charting tasks grants an additional 100,000 experience. Altogether, players are able to earn a total of 691,270 [[Sailing]] experience from these tasks. It is therefore worthwhile to complete these tasks in-between doing [[port tasks]] and [[Barracuda Trials]]. Experience bonus rewards for fully charting oceans must be claimed from [[Chartin' Charles McAtless]] in the [[Pandemonium Cave]] with [[Captain's log]] in your inventory. You can enter your username below to highlight and hide the tasks that you've finished. You can also see the [[Sailing/Map|'''interactive map''']] of all the sea charting tasks, with your completed tasks automatically highlighted. {{Sync}} ==Ardent Ocean== Completing all 69 tasks in the 16 seas of the [[Ardent Ocean]] requires level 38 Sailing{{Boostable|y}} and grants the player an ocean completion bonus of 5,000 experience, claimed from [[Chartin' Charles McAtless]] in the [[Pandemonium Cave]], for a total of 20,990 experience. {| class="wikitable lighttable sortable sticky-header sea-charting-table qc-active align-center-1 align-center-2 align-center-6 align-center-7" [[File:Current duck location ripples.png|thumb|right|A location where the [[current duck]] can be used.]] '''Current''' is a type of [[sea charting]] task that involves tracking sea currents using the [[current duck]]. As the duck is acquired as a reward from the [[Current Affairs]] quest, these tasks have a minimum requirement of at least 22 [[Sailing]]. To complete these tasks, set the [[current duck]] down in the water at a spot where the water has some distinct ripples and follow it to the end. The duck will drift along in the currents before eventually coming to a stop where you can then retrieve it and complete the task. Note that you do not need to escort the duck, you can go to the end location directly. The duck will only despawn a few minutes after it has arrived at its end location. ==Current task locations== {{Sync}} {| class="wikitable lighttable sortable sticky-header sea-charting-table qc-active align-center-1 align-center-5 align-center-6 {{#if:{{{collapsible|}}}|mw-collapsible|}}" ! style="width: 60px;" data-sort-value='level' | Level ! Task ! style="width: 150px;" | Sea ! style="width: 130px;" | Ocean ! class="unsortable" | Location ! style="width: 65px;" | Comp% {{SeaChartTypeTwoLocations|type=current|mapType=mapframe}} |} ==See also== * [[Sailing/Map]] for an interactive map of all charting tasks. {{Sea charting}} {{Sailing}}

[[File:Charting weather.gif|frame|A player uses a portable weather station to chart weather patterns.]] '''Weather''' is a type of [[sea charting]] task requiring at least level 57 [[Sailing]]{{boostable|yes}} that involves assisting [[Meaty Aura Logist]] in various locations by measuring weather patterns using the [[portable weather station]]. Despite being a [[sea charting]] activity, some weather data must be gathered on land. Once speaking with [[Meaty Aura Logist]], she will give you a [[portable weather station]] specific to that particular location. Then you must use it to get a reading at the location where there is no wind, before returning to [[Meaty Aura Logist]] to turn in the [[Data filled portable weather station]] and complete the task. Boosts may be used to hit the 57 Sailing requirement. Boosting is only required when starting and when getting a reading, handing in the data filled station to Meaty does not require a boost. ==Finding the weather== The correct locations from which [[Meaty Aura Logist]] wants weather data measurements are always at the centre of a [[wikipedia:Curl_(mathematics)|circular wind pattern]], where the wind has stopped. ===Going right for the centre=== First, establish if the wind is clockwise or anticlockwise by sailing in the same direction as your [[portable weather station]]'s readings until the wind changes. The centre of the circle will be approximately a 70-110 degree turn from the direction the wind is travelling, so turn about 90 degrees right if wind is clockwise, or about 90 degrees left if wind is anticlockwise. As you get close enough to the centre of the circle (or overshoot it), the wind direction you measure will at some point change (or stop). Re-adjust your heading to be a 90 degree turn away from the wind direction and continue until you find the centre. If you are in the right spot and cannot log the weather data, try to reverse the boat into the spot instead (especially when using a [[Sloop]]) or try using a [[Raft]] instead. {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible" |+In which direction is the centre? ! rowspan="2" |Portable weather station reading ! colspan="2" |Direction towards the centre |- !Clockwise wind !Anticlockwise wind |- |North west||North east||South west |- |North||East||West |- |North east||South east||North west |- |East||South||North |- |South east||South west||North east |- |South||West||East |- |South west||North west||South east |- |West||North||South |} ===Mapping the wind circle=== An alternate method is to measure the wind direction in various locations and write it down as arrows on top of a map of the area. From there, you can estimate where the centre will be and take additional readings to further refine your estimate if needed. Keep in mind that depending on how accurately and precisely you draw the wind arrows on your map, it may not match up with the exact location where you took the wind reading. ==Tile markers== '''{{Colour|red|Note:}}''' There appear to be multiple locations for each weather centre, so the exact tile locations provided by the wiki or Quest Helper plugin may be incorrect. Refer to the [[#Finding the weather]] section for help identifying the correct spot. {{Tile markers box|align=left|Module:Tile markers/Meaty Aura Logist.json}} {{clear|left}} ==Weather task locations== '''{{Colour|red|Note:}}''' There appear to be multiple locations for each weather centre, so the exact tile locations provided by the wiki or Quest Helper plugin may be incorrect. revision.text:
{{External|rs|rsc=Seaslug}} {{Infobox Item |name = Sea slug |image = [[File:Sea slug (item).png]] |release = [[9 September]] [[2002]] |update = Sea Slug Quest |members = Yes |quest = [[Sea Slug]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Drop |examine = A rather nasty looking crustacean. |value = 4 |weight = 0.226 |id = 1466 }} [[File:Sea slug (item) detail.png|left|160px]] A '''Sea slug''' is an item that players can pick up using the [[Telekinetic Grab]] spell on a [[sea slug]] that [[Kent]] knocks off the player during the [[Sea Slug]] [[quest]]. Without Telekinetic Grab, it will merely damage the player for 3 [[hitpoints]], causing them to exclaim "Ouch!" If dropped, players can only pick it up again using another Telekinetic Grab spell. Attempting to cast [[alchemy spells]] on a sea slug will fail with the message {{mes|Ugly parasites have feelings too!}} Sea slugs are one of a handful of lethal self-damaging items; most self-damaging items cannot kill the player. However, if the sea slug is left on the floor when an instance closes (e.g: death in most private instances, server update, etc.), the sea slug will be permanently deleted. ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 20 September 2006 |update = Slug Menace |change = The item was graphically updated with the rework of [[Sea Slug]]. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Sea slug (item) detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Sea slug (item) detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Sea slug (item) (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Sea slug (item).png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
20 September 2006 |20 September 2006 ⁠–
present |} ==Trivia== *A player can be damaged by them even on free to play worlds. {{Sea Slug}} [[Category:Forced speech]] [[Category:Self-damaging items]]

{{External|rs=Sea slug (species)}} {{otheruses|the species|the quest|Sea Slug}} {{Infobox NPC |version1 = Fishing Platform |version2 = Witchaven Dungeon |name = Sea slug |image = [[File:Sea Slug (NPC).png|250x250px]] |release1 = [[26 April]] [[2004]] |release2 = [[20 September]] [[2006]] |update1 = No |update2 = Slug Menace |members = Yes |quest1 = [[Sea Slug]] |quest2 = [[The Slug Menace]] |location1 = [[Fishing Platform]] |location2 = [[Witchaven Dungeon]] |options1 = Take |options2 = N/A |examine = A rather nasty looking crustacean. |map = No |id1 = 5061 |id2 = 4801 |leagueRegion = Kandarin }} '''Sea slugs''' (''Opisthobranchia alucinor'') are a race of slug-like creatures which are able to control the minds of humans by latching on to them. They are ruled by the [[Mother Mallum]]. ==History== ===Fishing Platform=== [[File:Fisherman (Fishing Platform).png|thumb|100px|One of the victims on the fishing platform.]] The sea slugs are first met in the [[Sea Slug]] quest, while investigating the disappearances of [[Kent]] and [[Kennith]]. The sea slugs were somehow caught by the fishermen on the [[Fishing Platform]] and brought aboard. The sea slugs then attached themselves onto the fishermen and possessed them. This caused their skin to look sickly yellow, and made them want to spread their possession. Luckily, with the aid of [[Player character|an adventurer]], Kent and Kennith managed to get away before also being possessed. ===Witchaven=== The next step in their plans was to free their leader from the prison in which the [[Temple Knights]] had sealed thousands of years ago. How they arrived at [[Witchaven]] is uncertain. [[Mayor Eustace Hobb]], the first villager to become possessed, announced he'd be renovating the [[Witchaven Dungeon|shrine]] to the west. [[Col. O'Niall]], a semi-retired Temple Knight, began noticing Hobb's unusual actions, including massive amounts of mining equipment and rune essence being brought to the village, along with some of its citizens disappearing overnight and returning in a dazed and confused state. Soon, with the aid of the Temple Knights, the adventurer created specially-shaped runes, believing they would reinforce the barrier that kept Mother Mallum at bay. However, the adventurer was tricked by Mayor Hobb into releasing her, due to the runes acting as keys to the barrier. Hobb sent the [[Slug Prince]] after them, but it was quickly slain by the adventurer. They then managed to narrowly escape Mother Mallum's possession attempt. Shortly after Mallum's escape, the rest of the population of Witchaven was possessed, with the town becoming the first in Gielinor to fall to the Sea Slugs. ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 20 September 2006 |update = Slug Menace |change = The NPC was graphically updated with the rework of Sea Slug. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Sea slug (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Sea Slug (NPC).png|center|300x150px]] |- |26 April 2004 –
20 September 2006 |20 September 2006 –
present |} ==Trivia== * According to a [[natural historian]] in [[Varrock Museum]], researchers that went to investigate the sea slugs would mysteriously send a letter of resignation before never being heard from again. Given the nature of the sea slugs, they were almost certainly possessed. * During [[Sea Slug]], [[Bailey]] refers to the creatures as crustaceans, though they are most likely members of the phylum Mollusca as other terrestrial slugs and most other sea slugs are. * In the Ghorrock Prison during [[Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire]], a sea slug can be seen in a jar on top of a dresser. * The [[Apothecary]] in [[Varrock]] has a sea slug contained in a jar on his cabinet. {{Sea Slug}} [[Category:Races]]

{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Sea slug glue |image = [[File:Sea slug glue.png]] |release = [[20 September]] [[2006]] |update = Slug Menace |members = Yes |quest = [[The Slug Menace]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Drop |examine = A rendered down baby sea slug. |value = 1 |weight = 0.010 |id = 9680 }} [[File:Sea slug glue detail.png|left|160px]] '''Sea slug glue''' is a [[quest items|quest item]] used in [[The Slug Menace]] [[quests|quest]]. It is made by giving a [[dead sea slug]] to [[Bailey]] on the [[Fishing Platform]] near [[Witchaven]]. The glue is used to join together [[Fragment 1|the]] [[Fragment 2|three]] [[Fragment 3|fragments]] of [[Page 3]] of Maledict's holy book, which is used later in the quest.
{{The Slug Menace}}

revision.text:
{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Seal of passage |image = [[File:Seal of passage.png]] |release = [[24 July]] [[2006]] |update = Lunar Diplomacy |members = Yes |quest = [[Lunar Diplomacy]] |tradeable = No |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Wear, Destroy |destroy = Brundt the Chieftain will probably have another lying around somewhere anyway... |examine = A seal of passage issued by Brundt the Chieftain of the Fremennik. |value = 1 |weight = 4.535 |id = 9083 |leagueRegion = Fremennik }} [[File:Seal of passage detail.png|left|150px]] A '''seal of passage''' is a [[neckwear slot]] item that is required to be worn or held in the inventory in order to talk to or trade with ''anyone'' on [[Lunar Isle]], except for [['Birds-Eye' Jack]], the banker available after [[Dream Mentor]]. Without it, players attempting to speak with anyone will be forcibly teleported from Lunar Isle back to [[Rellekka]]. The seal of passage is obtained at the beginning of the [[Lunar Diplomacy]] [[quest]] by talking to [[Brundt the Chieftain]] in the longhall in [[Rellekka]]. [[Brundt the Chieftain]] will replace it for free if the player destroys it or loses it. It is always lost on [[death]]. Because of this, it is recommended for players planning to return to Lunar Isle via Rellekka to destroy their seal of passage after each visit, as they can get a free replacement from [[Brundt the Chieftain|Brundt]] if they do not have one banked as Rellekka is a long way from a bank if a player forgets their seal. If [[The Fremennik Isles]] is started, [[Maria Gunnars]] will transport the player to [[Neitiznot]] where there is a [[bank]] to use. If a player loses their seal during the [[The Fremennik Exiles|Fremennik Exiles]] quest, they may have to talk to [[Brundt the Chieftain|Brundt]] south-east of Rellekka to reobtain it. Players who have completed the [[Fremennik diary|Fremennik Elite Diaries]] will no longer need to hold or wear a seal of passage in order to speak to the residents of Lunar Isle. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = neck |altimage = [[File:Seal of passage equipped female.png]] }} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 27 February 2020 |update = Game Improvements and Email Linking for Mobile Accounts |type = |change = The Seal of Passage is now positioned in the centre of the torso rather than to the side, and appears in front of any worn body slot item. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Seal of passage equipped v1.png|85px]] |[[File:Seal of passage equipped female.png|85px]] |- |24 July 2006–
27 February 2020 |27 February 2020 –
present |} ==Trivia== *At 4.535 kg, it is the heaviest item that can be worn in the neckwear slot. {{Lunar Diplomacy}}

/* Crate locations */ Mentioning in "Bottle of portal nexus perry" that you get teleported near the dark mage. This makes it clear that there's no danger from the monsters that are in the abyss. I don't know if people usually would say whether you get skulled or not, or would definitely mention if you were teleported to the outer ring, but I'm sure me not knowing that is indicative that others don't know that, so it should be in here.

revision.text:
{{External|rs|rsc=Stamped letter of recommendation}} {{Infobox Item |name = Sealed letter |image = [[File:Sealed letter.png]] |release = [[9 July]] [[2003]] |update = New Digsite Quest! |members = Yes |quest = [[The Dig Site]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Drop |examine = A sealed letter of recommendation. |value = 1 |weight = 0.020 |id = 683 }} [[File:Sealed letter detail.png|left|160px]] The '''sealed letter''' is a quest item used in [[The Dig Site]]. It is obtained by taking the [[unstamped letter]] to the [[Curator Haig Halen|Curator]] in [[Varrock]]'s museum. He will then add his seal to the letter and the player can then return to the digsite exam centre to continue the quest. If you happen to lose your sealed letter, you can acquire a replacement for free from the Curator. ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 22 August 2006 |update = New f2p prayers, port to port transport and improved dragon axe |change = *The item was graphically updated with the rework of [[The Dig Site]]. *The item was renamed from "Stamped letter" to "Sealed letter". }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Sealed letter detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Sealed letter detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Sealed letter (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Sealed letter.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
22 August 2006 |22 August 2006 ⁠–
present |} {{The Dig Site}}

revision.text:
{{Infobox Item |name = Searing boots |image = [[File:Searing boots.png]] |release = [[15 April]] [[2026]] |update = Leagues VI: Demonic Pacts - Launches Today! |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = |options = Wear, Destroy |destroy = You can get this item back by talking to the Leagues tutor in Yama's lair. |examine = Greaves that give you blazing speed. |value = 1 |weight = 0 |id = 28771 }} [[File:Searing boots detail.png|130px|left]] The '''Searing boots''' are footwear obtained during the [[Demonic Pacts League]], given to players who picked the [[Hotfoot (Demonic Pacts League)|Hotfoot]] relic.
Players wearing the boots earn <math>10+\lfloor(AgilityLvl*\tfrac{2}{3})\rfloor</math> [[Agility]] [[experience]] roughly every 10 [[ticks]] as they [[run]] before applying any League multipliers. For players to be eligible to gain experience as they run, the greaves simply check if the player has moved 2 [[game square]]s in 1 tick. This means that diagonal moves around objects will not count towards experience despite of technically taking 2 steps.
Although renamed for the [[Demonic Pacts League]], the boots have made past appearances as the [[Sage's greaves]].
==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = feet |image = [[File:Searing boots equipped male.png|150px]] |altimage = [[File:Searing boots equipped female.png|150px]] }}
==Active effects== While the searing boots are worn, players gain the following benefits: * [[Agility]] experience is gained based on Agility level while running. * Caught [[fish]] are automatically cooked. * Mined [[ore]] is automatically smelted.
The searing boots can be retrieved from the [[Leagues Tutor]] in [[Yama's Lair]] if lost.
{{Demonic Pacts League}}

{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Seasoned chompy |image = [[File:Seasoned chompy.png]] |release = [[18 May]] [[2004]] |update = Big Chompy Bird Hunting |members = Yes |quest = [[Big Chompy Bird Hunting]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Drop |examine = It has been deliciously seasoned to taste wonderful for ogres. |value = 10 |alchable = No |weight = 10.000 |id = 2882 }} [[File:Seasoned chompy detail.png|left|140px]] A '''seasoned chompy''' is used in the [[Big Chompy Bird Hunting]] quest. It is made by obtaining the seasonings specified by [[Rantz]], [[Fycie]] and [[Bugs]] and then cooking a [[raw chompy]] on the ogre spit roast with the seasoning items in your inventory. It is given to Rantz to complete the quest.
{{Big Chompy Bird Hunting}}

{{Cache}} {{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Seasoned legs |image = [[File:Seasoned legs.png]] |release = [[29 March]] [[2004]] |update = RS2 Launched! |removal = [[7 August]] [[2006]] |removalupdate = Gnome Cuisine |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Eat, Drop |examine = They're a gnome delicacy apparently. |value = 2 |weight = 0.150 |id = 2158 }} [[File:Seasoned legs detail.png|130px|left]] '''Seasoned legs''' were previously obtained during [[Gnome cooking]] when making a [[Toad batta]]. It could be made by adding [[Equa leaves]] and [[Gnome spice]] to some [[Toad's legs]]. They were then added to a [[Half baked batta]] alongside [[Cheese]], which was baked to create the Toad batta.
As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, the toad's legs, equa leaves and gnome spice are all automatically added at once to create a [[Half made batta (toad)|Half made batta]]. If the player attempts to add gnome spice or equa leaves to toad's legs, nothing happens.
Because the item was removed before 2007, it has never been present in ''Old School RuneScape''. However, it remains in the game files.
{{Gnome cooking}} {{Unobtainable items}} [[Category:Food]]

Well, I have the seaweed... |value = 5 |weight = 0.028 |id = 6679 }} [[File:Seaweed in a box detail.png|left|100px]] '''Seaweed in a box''' is made by adding [[ground seaweed]] to an [[empty fish food box]]. To obtain an empty box, players must talk to [[Harry]] in [[Catherby]] with a filled [[fishbowl]] in their inventory. To make the ground seaweed, the player must use [[seaweed]] with a [[pestle and mortar]]. Adding [[ground guam]] then turns it into [[fish food]] which can be fed to a player's [[pet fish]]. This is currently the only way to obtain fish food, other than picking it up in [[Draynor Manor]]. Making it provides no experience in any skills. ==Creation== {{Recipe |ticks = |members = Yes |mat1 = Ground seaweed |mat1quantity = 1 |mat1cost = No |mat2 = Empty fish food box |mat2quantity = 1 |mat2cost = No |output1 = Seaweed in a box |output1quantity = 1 |output1cost = No }} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 5 November 2025 |update = Sailing Technical Pre-Release |change = The item's examine text was changed; previously, it was "'Ingredients; Ground Guam and Ground Seaweed.' {{External|rs=Secret Entrance (Troll Stronghold)}} {{Infobox Scenery |name = Secret Door |image = [[File:Secret door.png|250x250px]] |release = [[24 August]] [[2004]] |update = Troll Stronghold Quest |members = Yes |quest = [[Troll Stronghold]] |location = [[Trollheim]] |options = Open |examine = The back way into the stronghold. |map = {{Map|x:2827,y:3647|plane=0|mapID=-1|mtype=pin}} |id = 3762 }}
The '''Secret Door''' is a door situated in a mountain passage between [[Burthorpe]] and the [[Fremennik Province]]. [[Climbing boots]] are required to access the area where the entrance is. This door grants access to the stronghold's lowest level, where the trolls keep their prisoners.

{{otheruses|the items obtained during the 2021 Christmas event|the holiday reward|Secret santa present}} {{Gone|update=Nex: The Fifth General}} {{Infobox Item |version1 = Red |version2 = Blue |version3 = Green |name = Secret santa present |image1 = [[File:Secret santa present (2021 Christmas event, red).png]] |image2 = [[File:Secret santa present (2021 Christmas event, blue).png]] |image3 = [[File:Secret santa present (2021 Christmas event, green).png]] |release = [[16 December]] [[2021]] |update = Christmas 2021 |removal = [[5 January]] [[2022]] |removalupdate = Android Beta Signup & Small QoL Changes |members = No |quest = None |tradeable = No |bankable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Read-tag, Open, Destroy |destroy = I can talk to Cecilia to retrieve this. |examine = A present that needs to be delivered. |value1 = 0 |value2 = 1 |value3 = 1 |alchable = No |weight = 0.001 |id1 = 26298 |id2 = 26300 |id3 = 26302 }} {{Synced switch |version1 = [[File:Secret santa present (2021 Christmas event, red) detail.png|left|150px]] |version2 = [[File:Secret santa present (2021 Christmas event, blue) detail.png|left|150px]] |version3 = [[File:Secret santa present (2021 Christmas event, green) detail.png|left|150px]] }} '''Secret santa presents''' were items received from [[Cecilia]] during the [[2021 Christmas event]]. There were three different coloured presents, each with a different riddle that indicates who to give it to. {{List|c=1| * Red - I like to sell chain. Protects you and I from pain. As always, prices wane. * Blue - Straw hats are fashion. Twenty is double fifteen. Woads are my passion. * Green - It grows on and on. I add colour, style and shape. Small talk is my song.}}
{{2021 Christmas event}}

revision.text:
{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Secret way map |image = [[File:Secret way map.png]] |release = [[9 August]] [[2004]] |update = Death Plateau Quest |members = Yes |quest = [[Death Plateau]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Drop |examine = This map shows the secret way up to Death Plateau. |value = 1 |alchable = No |weight = 0.005 |id = 3104 }} [[File:Secret way map detail.png|left|150px]] The '''Secret way map''' is a quest item used in the [[Death Plateau]] quest. It can be obtained by travelling to [[Tenzing]]'s mountain-side cabin near [[Burthorpe]] and giving him a pair of [[spiked boots]] made by [[Dunstan]] the blacksmith earlier in the quest. The map should then be taken to [[Denulth]], the leader of the [[Imperial Guard]] to complete the quest. If the map is lost before completion of the quest, [[Tenzing]] will draw another map for the player without requiring another pair of spiked boots.
{{Death Plateau}}

revision.text:
{{Has quick guide}} {{Infobox Quest |name = Secrets of the North |number = 156 |image = [[File:Secrets of the North.png|300px]] |release = [[11 January]] [[2023]] |update = Secrets of the North & More! |members = Yes |series = [[Quests/Series#Mahjarrat|Mahjarrat]], #13 |developer = [[Mod Ed]] }} [[File:Secrets of the North logo.png|left|200px]] '''Secrets of the North''' is a [[quest]] in the [[Quests/Series#Mahjarrat|Mahjarrat series]] announced during the [[Winter Summit 2022]].
In the quest, the player forms an alliance with the Mahjarrat [[Hazeel]] and [[General Khazard]] to try and solve the case of the sudden murder of Sir [[Ceril Carnillean]], ultimately leading to an [[Ghorrock Dungeon|ancient prison]] deep beneath [[Weiss]].
==Details== {{Quest details |start = The [[Carnillean Mansion]] in the south-west corner of [[East Ardougne]] |startmap = 2570,3276 |difficulty = Master |description = Our story begins - as all good murder mysteries do - with a mysterious murder, and there's no shortage of suspects - in fact, you're one of them! Be prepared to form an uneasy alliance, dig up secrets best left buried deep, and walk away with more questions than answers... |length = Medium |requirements = *{{SCP|Agility|69|link=yes}} {{Boostable|no}} {{Questreqstart|yes}} *{{SCP|Thieving|64|link=yes}} {{Boostable|no}} {{Questreqstart|yes}} *{{SCP|Hunter|56|link=yes}} {{Boostable|no}} {{Questreqstart|yes}} *Completion of the following quests: **[[Making Friends with My Arm]] ***[[My Arm's Big Adventure]] ****[[Eadgar's Ruse]] *****[[Druidic Ritual]] *****[[Troll Stronghold]] ******[[Death Plateau]] ****[[The Feud]] ****[[Jungle Potion]] ***[[Swan Song]] ****[[One Small Favour]] *****[[Rune Mysteries]] *****[[Shilo Village]] ****[[Garden of Tranquillity]] *****[[Creature of Fenkenstrain]] ******[[Priest in Peril]] ******[[The Restless Ghost]] ***[[Cold War]] ***[[Romeo & Juliet]] **[[The General's Shadow]] ***[[Curse of the Empty Lord]], for full [[ghostly robes]] ****Started [[Desert Treasure I]], for the [[ring of visibility]] ***[[Fight Arena]] **[[Devious Minds]] ***[[Wanted!]] ****[[Recruitment Drive]] *****[[Black Knights' Fortress]] *****[[Druidic Ritual]] ****[[The Lost Tribe]] *****[[Goblin Diplomacy]] *****[[Rune Mysteries]] ****[[Priest in Peril]] ***[[Doric's Quest]] ***[[Enter the Abyss]] **[[Hazeel Cult]] |items = *100 [[Coins]] *[[Lockpick]] ([[Strange Old Lockpick]] does NOT work) *[[Tinderbox]] (obtainable during the quest) |recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|85|link=yes}} * Antipoison or other form of poison protection * Any Ardougne cloak to teleport near several quest locations * [[Icy basalt]] to teleport to [[Weiss]] |kills = * [[Evelot]] ''(level 148)'' * [[Assassin]] ''(level 262)'' * [[Strange Creature]] ''(level 368)'' |leagueRegion = <poem> Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Desert}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest '''but will not auto-complete''' [[Desert Treasure I]] </poem> }}
==A Death in the Family== [[File:Guard (Carnillean) chathead.png|left]] [[File:Secrets of the North - Ceril's corpse.png|thumb|280px|The scene of the crime in the Carnillean Mansion.]] To start the quest, talk to the [[Guard (Carnillean)|guard]] outside of the [[Carnillean Mansion]] in [[East Ardougne]]; the fastest way to reach it is to teleport to the [[Battlefield]] by way of [[spirit tree]]. The guard will ask for your help in solving a crime.
{{Bug|The guard will not ask for your help if you have just completed Hazeel Cult. Logging out and in will fix the issue.}}
Follow the guard upstairs and finish the conversation to learn about the murder of [[Ceril Carnillean]]. Inspect Ceril's corpse to discover that Ceril was stabbed in the back with an "unusually thin blade". Inspect the eastern window to learn that it was broken from the outside. Finally, knock-at the northern wall to reveal a hidden room. Climb up the ladder, and inspect the chest to find that it has been broken into and emptied.
Return to the guard and tell him about these findings, and he will then show you an amulet that was found by the window. The amulet bears the symbol of the Khazard Army, with 'Evelot' engraved into the back. He suggests you search for more information at the Fight Arena bar, as he can't investigate the Khazard Army himself, because the army operates with approval from the monarchy.
==On the Trail== {{Needed|100 coins, Food, [[Combat equipment]] to defeat [[Evelot]] (level 148)}} [[File:Secrets of the North - tracking Evelot.png|thumb|220px|Tracking down Evelot around the Fight Arena.]] Make your way south to the [[Fight Arena Bar|bar]] in the south-west corner of the [[Fight Arena (location)|Fight Arena]]. Players can reach the area quickly by use of the [[Watchtower Teleport|Watchtower]] or [[Yanille teleport]]s, or the [[Ardougne cloak|Ardougne Cloak]]. Upon arrival, ask the [[Khazard Barman]] if he knows anyone named 'Evelot', and give him 100 coins as a bribe.
He says that she recently left in a hurry, and suggests looking around outside. Inspect the barrels just outside the bar entrance to begin tracking Evelot. Next, search the north-west boulders at the end of the trail, then the north-east bush, the tree stump, another set of boulders, and finally another bush (east of you). The trail will lead you clockwise around the periphery of the arena to a rowboat just south of the [[Tower of Life (building)|Tower of Life]], where Evelot will be standing. Upon approaching her, you will enter an instance; she will engage in a short dialogue, after which you will have to fight her.
===Fighting Evelot=== [[File:Secrets of the North - Evelot bush.png|alt=Evelot pseudo safespot bush|thumb|Evelot pseudo safespot bush.|200px]] Evelot attacks with melee, which can be completely blocked with the [[Protect from Melee]] prayer. However, every few attacks, she will use a special attack that disables protection prayers and drains prayer points, so be ready to turn them on and drink a restoration potion if needed. Be warned that even with good armour, Evelot can still hit up to 35 without protection, and she is moderately accurate.
Evelot is weakest to magic attacks, and has decent melee defence. However, moderately high level players should have no problem dispatching her with melee anyway, especially with a crush weapon. Note that she uses routefinding and therefore cannot be safespotted, and she is also immune to [[Bind|binds]] and [[Ice spells|freeze]] spells. If you run too far away, the fight will end and you must restart. However, the searchable plant right next to her rowboat can be shot over, and since she only moves at walking speed it is possible to kite her around it while staying within the instance. If done properly, this method functions as a slightly more effort-intensive safespot and makes it possible to easily beat her without ever being exposed to any damage. If you die during this fight, your gravestone will appear south of the Tower of Life, outside the fight instance.
When defeated, she will tell you about her role in the crime; she was hired to break in and steal a [[Hazeel scroll|certain scroll]] from the Carnillean mansion, but insists that she was not Ceril's killer. She then delivered the scroll to the Hazeel cultists, only to discover that they did not hire her to retrieve it.
==The Mysterious Benefactor== {{Needed|[[Lockpick]] or [[hair clip]]|recommended=[[Ardougne cloak]] (for fast teleport to Hazeel)}} Make your way to the Hazeel Cult, by the cave entrance to the [[Ardougne Sewers]] slightly north-west of the [[Ardougne Monastery]] and east of the [[Clock Tower (building)|Clock Tower]]. Players can reach the area quickly by teleporting to the monastery via an [[Ardougne cloak]]. Board the raft upon entry (if the raft is not moving, make sure all [[sewer valve]]s are in the [[Hazeel Cult|correct position]]), and talk to [[Alomone]] who will summon [[Hazeel]] or go directly to Clivet and Hazeel if you killed Alomone previously (Hazeel has been awakened regardless of the player's actions during the quest [[Hazeel Cult]]). Suspicious of the mysterious third party's intentions, [[Clivet]] is instructed to summon [[Khazard]] to the cult dungeon, where the two Mahjarrat discuss the third party still at large. Hazeel suggests that you return to the mansion and question the Carnillean family to find more information. [[File:Secrets of the North - lockpicking puzzle.png|thumb|280px|Picking the lock on the chest.]] Return to the Carnillean mansion, and update the guard with your progress; you must talk to the guard before questioning the family, who will otherwise refuse to talk to you. Philipe and Henryeta will not provide much of use, but [[Claus the Chef]] in the basement reveals that he felt a sudden feeling of cold around the time of the murder, and saw a shadow. Searching the south-west shelves reveals a small button that unlocks a wall on the north side of the room, next to the noticeboard. Inspect the wall to enter the passage behind this wall and picklock the chest in the room.
To pick the lock, move the pins along to specific positions. They will appear '''blue''' if the number is correct but in the wrong position, and '''green''' if that pin is at the correct position. Multiple pins can have the same number. The ordering does not change attempt to attempt. Players who have difficulty picking the lock can use a [[wikipedia:Mastermind_(board_game)|Mastermind]] solver to decode the pins. Fastest method is to guess all 1, anything not green change to 2s and confirm again. anything not green moves to 3, and so forth. You will solve in max 6 guesses.
Inside the chest you will find a [[Dusty scroll (Secrets of the North)|dusty scroll]]. Inspect the scroll to see a faded symbol, then take the scroll back to Hazeel and Khazard, who become mysteriously concerned and decide that it's time to return to the North. As Hazeel does not wish to attract any attention from the other Mahjarrat, and since you are on friendly terms with the ice trolls of [[Weiss]], he asks that you accompany them there.
==In the North== {{Needed|Combat equipment to defeat the [[assassin]]|recommended=Antipoison, [[icy basalt]] (to teleport to Weiss)}} Head to the northern entrance of [[Weiss]]. The fastest way to reach the entrance is to use the [[icy basalt]] teleport, cross the [[little boulder]] immediately to the east, squeeze through the nearby [[Broken fence (Weiss)|broken fence]], and run slightly north-east. Just outside the central area, you will find [[Dead Wolf]] and [[Big Fish (Secrets of the North)|Big Fish]], who are shapeshifted manifestations of [[General Khazard]] and [[Hazeel]]. They will have you speak to [[Snowflake]] and [[My Arm]] and see if they have seen anything odd recently; My Arm will tell you that there was recently a cave-in down in the mine and that [[Goat Poo]] saw a strange shadow whilst investigating it.
Return to Big Fish, who reveals that the area used to be [[Ghorrock]], a settlement of the [[Zarosian Empire]] during the [[Second Age]], and that the missing crest half was used to seal the prison below. You then tell them of what Snowflake and My Arm told you, and they tell will ask you to meet them in the [[Salt Mine]].
'''Important: Be fully prepared for combat before entering the cave. Make sure to bring antipoisons.'''
===Fighting the Assassin=== [[File:Secrets of the North - fighting the assassin.png|thumb|280px|The player and Khazard fight the assassin.]] Head down the stairs in the main building, and go through the southern cave entrance that's opened up into the prison. This will begin a cutscene where you and Khazard come across an [[assassin]] that you've met during the events of [[Devious Minds]]. He will attack you.
The assassin, still retaining the [[bow-sword]] that you made for him before, will attack with both ranged and melee; he will react accordingly to protection prayers, so pray against what you're weakest against. General Khazard will assist you in the fight, but don't expect him to handle the assassin completely.
The assassin cannot be damaged in normal combat, as he is too fast; should you attack him, your chat will read: {{Mes|The assassin easily dodges your attack. You'll need to obscure his vision somehow.|colour=purple|size=14pt|shadow=no}} To damage him, wait until he throws smoke bombs around the room; once one lands, he can be lured into it, obscuring his vision and allowing him to be hurt.
The assassin will also throw green vials, which will deal up to 30 damage and inflict [[poison]] starting at 6 damage; they're similar in appearance to [[Divine super combat potion|super combat potions]] and can be avoided by simply running one tile away when you see the animation begin.
'''Note:''' If you die during this fight, your gravestone will appear inside the Salt Mine, outside the cave entrance to Ghorrock Dungeon.
After the fight, the assassin will seemingly vanish; Khazard demands an explanation as to how you knew them. After learning of the events, he tells you to talk to Hazeel while he guards the door leading to the prison. Hazeel deduces that a third Mahjarrat may still be hiding nearby with the other half of the crest required to unseal the prison, as two of his Zarosian kin had sealed away a dangerous [[Duke Sucellus|abomination]] in there and rumours began to swirl that a powerful artefact was also sealed with it. While he guards the exit to the dungeon, he tasks you with investigating the area for him.
==Secrets of the Dungeon== {{Needed|[[Tinderbox]] - obtainable from a crate near where it is needed.|recommended=}} Begin searching various accessible objects in the area and acquire the required items: * [[Ancient map]] - crate in the easternmost part of the dungeon * [[Lever handle]] - barrel of weapons south of the centre room * [[Tullia's letter]] - chest in the south-eastern room * [[Duke note]] - damaged table in the south-eastern room
Read Tullia's letter and make note of the purple letters: "S, p, c, d, l". By using the ancient map and moving from '''S'''enntisten, '''P'''addewwa, '''C'''arrallanger, '''D'''areeyak, and '''L'''assar, the direction moved would be left, up, left, and down. Input these into the northern gate's lock then press "Confirm" to open it.
Next, search the chest inside for a [[strange list]]. Then, use the handle on the lever mechanism, and pull it. Head to the room where you fought the assassin, and inspect the south-western pillar to find a [[jewel shard]] and a [[strange cipher]].
Use the strange list to fill in the blank letters in the Duke note (for example, the first name in the Duke note is Picus), and then match the symbols with the letters in the strange cipher. For example, the symbol for Orcus is >, which the strange cipher displays as the letter L. [[File:Secrets of the North - investigating the dungeon.png|thumb|280px|The player investigates the Ghorrock Dungeon on behalf of the Mahjarrat.]] Correctly filling in the Duke note, combined with the symbols from the strange list and cipher, will uncover the hidden message "BOUND BY BLOOD". BLOOD is the passcode to the gate in the centre of the dungeon; input the letters into the lock and enter the gate.
Search the damaged table in the southern part of the room to receive a [[numbers note]], and the crate in the western part for a [[tinderbox]]. Reading it shows the player the number 3241, with "4: NE" on the top left. Each number corresponds to the location of a brazier, and certain texts you've acquired have this indicator; the strange cipher contains "1: SW", the ancient map contains "2: SE", and the strange list contains "3: NW". Using the numbers note, you must light the braziers in this order: north-west, south-east, north-east, and lastly south-west. This unlocks the western chest. Be aware that the NW and SW are written on the right-hand-side and the NE and SE are written on the left-hand-side, this is mirrored compared to a map where east is right and west is left.
Search the chest to receive a [[settlements note]] and another [[jewel shard]]. Use one shard on the other to create the [[ancient jewel]]; this will be used shortly. Read the settlements note, showing an arrangement of old Zarosian settlements. Using the ancient map, connect each settlement as instructed in the settlements note. For example, connecting "Kharid-et - Kharyrll - Senntisten" on the ancient map gives the player the shape of the number 7. Performing this for the other three lines on the note in order will give the player the number 7402, which is the passcode for the northern chest. Input the passcode to receive an [[icy chest]].
Use the ancient jewel on the icy chest to open it, giving the [[icy key]]; use it to unlock the gate south-west of the centre room. A crevice can be found beyond the gate; before entering, it is recommended to resupply and re-gear for both magic and ranged.
==A Strange "Something"== {{Needed|Ranged and Magic [[combat equipment]] to defeat the [[Strange Creature]] (level 368)|recommended=[[Stamina potion]]s, [[prayer potion]]s, [[ranging potion]]s, [[magic potion]]s or [[ancient brew|ancient]]/[[forgotten brew]]s}} [[File:Secrets of the North - fighting the strange creature.png|thumb|280px|The player fights the Strange Creature.]] Enter the crevice, where a [[Strange Creature]] will appear and attack. While the boss is among the more challenging quest monsters, players who familiarise themselves with its mechanics will find it to be a reasonable fight; with practice, a player of 85+ combat should be able to defeat the creature with decent gear such as [[blessed dragonhide armour]] and enchanted [[onyx jewellery]]. Stamina potions and a form of prayer restore are both strongly recommended.
Be sure to read the descriptions of its attacks in order to prepare yourself for the fight.
===Overview=== Following the quest, the strange creature's residual energy remains in the form of a stronger variant, the [[Phantom Muspah]], which can be fought repeatedly as a [[boss]].
The creature has 550 Hitpoints, and attacks with both Melee and Ranged. The creature has four forms which it transitions through during the fight after taking a set amount of damage: {| class="wikitable align-center-1 align-center-2 align-center-3 align-center-4 align-center-6" |+Carapace colours !Colour !Attacks !Pray against !Player attack !Tactic !Max hit |- |Brown [[File:Strange Creature (melee).png|frameless|width=150x150]] |Melee only [[File:Attack icon (detail).png|frameless|width=30x30]] |Melee [[File:Protect from Melee.png|frameless]] |Magic[[File:Magic icon (detail).png|frameless|width=30x30]] or Ranged[[File:Ranged icon (detail).png|frameless|width=30x30]] |Keep a distance and '''attack with Magic or Ranged'''. Be prepared to '''Protect from Melee''' if you accidentally get too close to the creature, but be advised that this will only partially reduce damage. Ensure that you bring several [[stamina potion]]s.
For those with access to good gear, Magic is advisable, as the creature has reduced Magic defence during this phase. If using Magic and Ranged, a switch of gear may be beneficial here to improve your chances of hitting the creature. Freezing it with [[ice spells]] is also viable during this phase, but note that freezes are 25% less effective than normal, meaning it will only stay frozen for 75% of the base freeze duration of ice spells.
While the Creature has reduced magic defence during this phase, it still has a Magic level of 150, making splashes quite frequent. Players without max gear or a high Magic level may find it more viable to remain ranging this phase, using the special effect of [[ruby bolts (e)]] to rapidly lower its health and end the phase quickly.
'''Note:''' During this phase, the creature has +160 Ranged Defence, so equipment with high Ranged attack bonuses is recommended if ranging. |24 |- |Green [[File:Strange Creature (ranged).png|frameless|width=151x151]] |Magic[[File:Magic icon (detail).png|frameless|width=30x30]] Ranged[[File:Ranged icon (detail).png|frameless|width=30x30]] |Ranged [[File:Protect from Missiles.png|frameless]] |Ranged [[File:Ranged icon (detail).png|frameless|width=30x30]] |'''Attack with Ranged''' and have your prayer book open. Be prepared to '''Protect from Magic''' if necessary, and switch back to range after. No running is necessary for this phase; additionally, the correct protection prayers will negate most damage (you will still take a small bit of chip damage). |33 |- |Teal (Prayer shield) [[File:Strange Creature (shielded).png|frameless|width=150x150]] |Magic[[File:Magic icon (detail).png|frameless|width=30x30]] Ranged[[File:Ranged icon (detail).png|frameless|width=30x30]] |Ranged [[File:Protect from Missiles.png|frameless]] |Ranged [[File:Ranged icon (detail).png|frameless|width=30x30]] |As soon as the Creature teleports to the centre of the room, '''run behind nearby spikes''' to avoid its shockwave. Attack the same as during the green phase, <u>'''always'''</u> praying against magic when necessary. When the shield appears, switch to [[Smite]] during attacks if possible; the shield will slowly disappear on its own, but Smite speeds up this process dramatically. It is also advised to use [[sapphire bolts (e)]] if using a crossbow for this phase, as it has a chance of draining a majority of the creature's prayer shield.
This form only appears once, when the creature is at 20% health. Damage received by the player during this phase will partially heal the creature after the shield is drained. |38 |- |Green (post-shield) |Magic[[File:Magic icon (detail).png|frameless|width=30x30]] Ranged[[File:Ranged icon (detail).png|frameless|width=30x30]] |Ranged [[File:Protect from Missiles.png|frameless]] |Ranged [[File:Ranged icon (detail).png|frameless|width=30x30]] |'''Attack with Ranged''', with your prayer book open, prepared to '''Protect from Magic''' if necessary. '''Note:''' During this phase, change of attack styles becomes more frequent, spikes spawn in frequently across the whole map. |38 |} {| class="wikitable align-center-3 align-center-4" |+Additional attacks !Animation !Attack !Pray against !Max hit |- |Raising arms and charging purple energy |Strong magic attack that, if not blocked, will inflict prayer-draining [[Corruption (status)|corruption]]. |Magic |33 |- |Slamming spikes into the ground |Spikes that damage the player and heal the creature. It will also shove the player to an adjacent tile. Spikes will '''always''' appear on the player's location when it changes forms. |N/A, Run |14 (?) |- |Creature disappearing and dimming of screen |A barrage of orbs will appear, damaging players if they touch them. |N/A, Run |14 (?) |- |Creature howling and spikes moving towards player |Spikes will home in on the player, damaging them as listed above. This can happen during any phase. |N/A, Run |14 (?) |- |Teleporting to center |Shockwave, which cannot be protected against. This attack only happens once. |See above |40 |}
'''Note:''' If you die during the boss fight, your [[gravestone]] will appear inside the [[salt mine]], outside the cave entrance to [[Ghorrock Dungeon]]. This acts as a normal [[deathpile]] for ultimate ironmen.
==More Mahjarrat, More Problems== [[File:Secrets of the North - Jhallan and the assassin.png|thumb|280px|The assassin approaches Jhallan.]] Once the creature is defeated, it will transform into [[Jhallan]], another [[Mahjarrat]]. He then notices you and attempts to question you, but before anything can happen, the assassin appears and casts a spell on Jhallan, teleporting him away, and disappearing again.
You will report what happened to Hazeel and Khazard, just as the strange barrier dissipates, unsealing the prison. They will realise the assassin is capable of entering the [[Shadow Realm]]. Khazard will leave behind a regiment of troops to secure the area, and Hazeel will offer you a teleport back to East Ardougne. Accept the teleport, and report back to the guard to complete the quest.
'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
==Rewards== {{Quest rewards |name = Secrets of the North |image = [[File:Secrets of the North reward scroll.png|center]] |qp = 2 |rewards = *{{SCP|Agility|60,000|link=yes}} [[experience]] *{{SCP|Thieving|50,000|link=yes}} [[experience]] *{{SCP|Hunter|40,000|link=yes}} [[experience]] * Ability to mine [[ancient essence crystals]] in the [[Ghorrock Dungeon]] * Access to a stronger version of the [[Strange Creature]], the [[Phantom Muspah]] }}
==Required for completing== * [[Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire]]
==Transcript== {{Hastranscript|quest}}
==Music== {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !Name ! class="unsortable" | Unlock details ! class="unsortable" | Music track |- |[[Secrets of the North (music track)|Secrets of the North]] |Unlocked upon entering the [[Ghorrock Dungeon]] |[[File:Secrets of the North.ogg]] |- |[[In the Shadows]] |Unlocked during the fight with the [[assassin]] |[[File:In the Shadows.ogg]] |- |[[More Than Meets the Eye]] |Unlocked during the fight with the [[Strange Creature]] |[[File:More Than Meets the Eye.ogg]] |}
==Trivia== * The equivalent of this quest in ''RuneScape 3'' is {{RSL|The Tale of the Muspah}}, though there are substantial story changes owing to the differences in the two games' Mahjarrat quest lines. * The quest was first pitched as a nameless master-level quest, with vague details about the plot, the quest boss, and its rewards for defeating it post-quest, whose names were changed to keep the Zarosian nature of the rewards a secret. The true name of the quest and its rewards from the boss were later revealed in the [[Winter Summit 2022]] a month later. * At the end of many [[Quests/Series|Mahjarrat quests]], the importance of the north is mentioned via the many [[Mahjarrat]] telling the player or other that they "will meet again in the north".
{{Secrets of the North}}

{{Infobox Scenery |version1 = Blue |version2 = Yellow |name = Security Barrier |image1 = [[File:Security Barrier (blue).png|250x250px]] |image2 = [[File:Security Barrier (yellow).png|250x250px]] |release = [[14 April]] [[2021]] |update = Below Ice Mountain |members = No |quest = [[Below Ice Mountain]] |location = [[Ruins of Camdozaal]] |options1 = None |options2 = Enter |examine = Built to protect the Vault from intruders. |map1 = {{Map|mapID=-1|2957,5852|2984,5852|2959,5848|2968,5848|2980,5847|2964,5844|2959,5838|2956,5836|2968,5835|2976,5835|2954,5831|2970,5832|2964,5829|2980,5829|2984,5829|2972,5827|2977,5825|mtype=pin}} |map2 = {{Map|mapID=-1|2974,5852|2968,5848|2980,5847|2964,5844|2968,5835|2976,5835|2954,5831|2970,5832|2980,5829|2984,5829|mtype=pin}} |id1 = 41540 |id2 = 41539 }} '''Security Barriers''' are found at the [[Camdozaal Vault]] where players have 60 seconds to navigate to find lockboxes that contain increasingly valuable rewards.
{{Ruins of Camdozaal}}

{{External|rs}} {{Infobox NPC |name = Security Guard |image = [[File:Security Guard.png|220px]] |release = [[4 July]] [[2006]] |update = Security and free-to-play update - the Stronghold of Security |size = 1 |members = No |location = [[Port Sarim jail]] |examine = A retired Security Guard. |map = {{Map|name=Security Guard|3013,3192|plane=1|r=3|mtype=square}} |id = 5442 |leagueRegion = Asgarnia }} [[File:Security Guard chathead.png|left]] The '''Security Guard''' can be found on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Port Sarim jail]]. He hands out the [[security book]]. Claiming that book from him is an easy task in the [[Falador_Diary#Easy|Falador Diary]].
He is the twin brother of the now-removed [[Account security tutor]], who used to be in the [[Lumbridge Graveyard]].
==Former random event== The Security Guard used to be a [[Random events|random event]]. If the player had their recovery questions set, he would give them a [[security book]] and possibly a reward. If the player already had a security book in their [[inventory]], he would not provide another one.
The possible rewards included: *20, 40, 80, 160, 320, or 640 [[coins]] *Uncut [[gems]] ([[sapphire]]s, [[emerald]]s, [[ruby|rubies]], or [[diamond]]s) *[[Half key]] ([[members]] only) *[[Cosmic talisman]] (members only) *[[Spinach roll]] *[[Kebab]]
The player was recommended by the Security Guard to visit the [[Stronghold of Security]]. Despite advertising the Stronghold, he could still appear when you actually ''were'' in the Stronghold.
If ignored for too long, the guard would attack the player. He could be attacked and killed, but this was not recommended: despite his max hit of 2, he had high [[Defence]] and a total of 250 [[Hitpoints]], and each point of damage dealt to him yielded only a quarter of an [[experience]] point. Furthermore, he was immune to [[poison]]. If the player took too long to kill him, he would eventually disappear. If the player teleported away, he would say '' '[He/She] got away!' '' before disappearing.
==Dialogue== {{Hastranscript|npc}}
{{Discontinued random events}} {{Port Sarim}}

{{external|rs=Seed bag}} {{otheruses|the Tithe Farm reward|the reward from [[farming contract]]s|seed pack}} {{Bug|While [[coral]] frags can be stored in the seed box, they will not automatically be stored in an open seed box while thieving from sailing chests}} {{Infobox Item |version1 = Closed |version2 = Open |name1 = Seed box |name2 = Open seed box |image1 = [[File:Seed box.png]] |image2 = [[File:Open seed box.png]] |release1 = [[4 February]] [[2016]] |release2 = [[23 January]] [[2020]] |update1 = Tournament Worlds & Tithe |update2 = Wiki Integration |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options1 = Fill, Empty, Check, Open, Destroy |options2 = Fill, Empty, Check, Close, Destroy |destroy = You can get another seed box from Farmer Gricoller's Reward Shop. {{Colour|#ff0000|Any seeds within the box will also be destroyed.}} |examine = A handy box for carrying some seeds. |value = 10 |weight = 1.000 |id1 = 13639 |id2 = 24482 |leagueRegion = Kourend }} {{Synced switch |version1 = [[File:Seed box detail.png|left|120px]] |version2 = [[File:Open seed box detail.png|left|120px]] }} The '''seed box''' is an item that can store up to 2,147,483,647 [[seeds]] of six different types. It is purchased from [[Farmer Gricoller]] at the [[Tithe Farm]] for 250 points. This item can be used directly on a [[Farming/Patch locations|farming patch]]. Using the box on a patch will automatically plant the first applicable seed of that patch's type, which can be reordered. Players can right-click to open the box, which will have seeds that the player picks up be automatically placed inside the box, provided there is space for it. Although [[frags]] and [[mushroom spores]] are not taxonomically seeds, they can still be stored in the seed box. Like [[Gricoller's can]], players can only own one seed box at a time. It is useful to bring to [[Slayer]] tasks and bosses which drop a large variety of seeds commonly, such as [[nechryael]], to save inventory space. [[Ironman Mode|Ultimate Ironman]] players may find the seed box very useful, as it saves up to five inventory spaces while training [[Farming]] and [[Herblore]]. It is also useful to bring while [[shipwreck salvaging]] due to the number of seeds and frags different shipwrecks provide, particularly at [[Large shipwreck|large shipwrecks]] and [[Merchant shipwreck|merchant shipwrecks]]. Seeds gained from sorting salvage do not automatically go into an opened seed box.[[File:Seed box interface.png|thumb|left|The interface when checking the seed box.]] Upon death to an NPC, including deaths below level 20 [[Wilderness]], the seed box will go to the gravestone with all of its contents still stored. However, if the player dies above level 20 Wilderness, the seed box will be destroyed but the contents preserved within the next box acquired. For Ultimate Ironman players, deaths above level 20 Wilderness will result in the seed box being destroyed, and all of its contents dropping to ground. The seed box is always lost upon death in PvP. In [[Deadman Mode]], the seed box is lost upon death, even when stored in the bank and empty. [[File:Ultimate_ironman_chat_badge.png]] Note: The seeds within the seed box can be safely [[Ultimate_Ironman_Guide/Item_Management#Ghost_Storage|ghostbanked]] by dying whilst it is in a deathbank interface such as [[Hespori]]. ==Shop locations== {{Store locations list|Seed box}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 3 June 2026 |update = New Regional Worlds Launch TODAY! |change = * Using a seed box on a [[Farming/Patch locations|Farming patch]] will now automatically attempt to plant the first seed suitable for that patch. * Seeds can now be reordered in the seed box interface by right-clicking the box and selecting "Check". }} {{Subject changes |date = 6 May 2026 |update = Further Leagues VI Changes |change = The seed box now works with looting Sailing creatures while opened. }} {{Subject changes |date = 20 July 2022 |update = Activity Adviser: Phase One |change = The seed box now lists its content in chat when checked, even if the interface doesn't remain open. If it is open, the list will appear when closing the interface, thus giving the most up-to-date status of the box. }} {{Subject changes |date = 14 April 2021 |update = Below Ice Mountain |change = Upon death above level 20 wilderness the seed box will now be destroyed but its content preserved within the next box acquired. This does not work for UIM Accounts }} {{Subject changes |date = 16 April 2020 |update = Poll 70 Game Improvements |poll = Old School Content Poll 70: Game Improvements |change = Seeds pickpocketed from [[Master Farmer]]s will now be directly placed into an open seed box. }} {{Subject changes |date = 23 January 2020 |update = Wiki Integration |poll = Old School Content Poll 69: Game Improvements |change = *Open and close options have been added, which allows seeds that the player picks up be automatically placed inside the box while opened, providing there is space for it. *The item's name was changed from "Seed box" to "Open seed box", while the closed version was given the open box's item name. *The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |date = 24 January 2019 |update = Boxing Mechanics and Lots of Fixes |change = Shift-clicking now empties the contents into the inventory. }} {{Subject changes |date = 14 April 2016 |update = Bank Placeholders & PID |change = The "Check" and "Fill" options were swapped, so Fill is now left-click. }} {{Subject changes |date = 11 February 2016 |update = Tournament Stats & Skilling QoL |poll = |change = The weight of the seed box was reduced from 6kg to 1 kg. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Seed box (v1) detail.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Seed box detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Seed box v1.png|center]] |[[File:Seed box.png|center]] |- |4 February 2016 –

{{External|rs}} A '''seedling''' is a tree [[seed]] that has been planted in a filled [[plant pot]]. To plant the seed, use the seed on the plant pot while a [[gardening trowel]] is in your inventory.
Seedlings grow into [[sapling]]s within the next five minutes after being watered with a [[watering can]] or the [[humidify]] spell (based on the [[Farming#Growth timing|growth ticks]]). After watering there will be a "(w)" at the end of the plant pot name indicating it has been watered. A watered seedling will still grow into a sapling even if logged out, so if boosting it is recommended to be logged out during this period to preserve the boost since the skill level check will happen again when attempting to plant in a farming patch.
Planting a seed in a plant pot requires the appropriate [[Farming]] level required to plant the sapling in the relevant [[tree patch]], although [[temporary skill boost]]s like a [[Garden pie]] do work.
Seedlings may be deposited into a [[bank]] and grow into saplings while stored. If unable to find a seedling that you have deposited, check Tab 1. Saplings revert to the top tab if that type of sapling isn't already present elsewhere in the bank, and stack in the bank although not in inventory.
==List of seedlings== ===Wood trees=== *[[Oak seedling]] *[[Willow seedling]] *[[Maple seedling]] *[[Yew seedling]] *[[Magic seedling]]
===Fruit trees=== *[[Apple seedling]] *[[Banana seedling]] *[[Orange seedling]] *[[Curry seedling]] *[[Papaya seedling]] *[[Pineapple seedling]] *[[Palm seedling]] *[[Dragonfruit seedling]]
===Hardwood trees=== *[[Teak seedling]] *[[Mahogany seedling]] *[[Camphor seedling]] *[[Ironwood seedling]] *[[Rosewood seedling]]
===Special=== *[[Calquat seedling]] *[[Spirit seedling]] *[[Celastrus seedling]] *[[Redwood seedling]] *[[Crystal seedling]]
==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 30 January 2014 |update = Release the Kraken! |poll = Old School feature poll 15: Rejuvenating the Wilderness |change = Watered saplings have had a (w) appended to their name. }} {{Subject changes footer}}
{{Seedling}} [[Category:Farming]]

{{External|rs|dw}} '''Seeds''' are items that members use to grow crops with the [[Farming]] skill. There are currently category = Seeds notcategory = Chambers of Xeric notcategory = Discontinued content notcategory = Quest items notcategory = Unbankable items titlematch = % seed titlematch = % spore titlematch = Acorn titlematch = Gout tuber nottitlematch = Adamant% nottitlematch = Mithril% nottitlematch = Seed dibber mode = userformat resultsheader = %TOTALPAGES% seeds in the game. Growth times given here are minimum times. [[Disease (Farming)|Disease]]s can occur at the end of a growth cycle and prevents advancement to the next cycle, essentially causing the cycle to be repeated. Using [[compost]], [[supercompost]] or [[ultracompost]] reduces the occurrence of repeated cycles through disease, helping to ensure the speediest growth. The [[amulet of bounty]] can be used to save allotment seeds, providing a 25% chance for 1 seed to be used instead of 3. Most seeds that are not used in quests or activities can be deposited into the [[seed vault]] in the [[Farming Guild]]. {{:Allotment patch/Seeds|main=yes}} {{:Flower patch/Seeds|main=yes}} {{:Herb patch/Seeds|main=yes}} {{:Hops patch/Seeds|main=yes}} {{:Bush patch/Seeds|main=yes}} {{:Tree patch/Seeds|main=yes}} {{:Fruit tree patch/Seeds|main=yes}} {{:Special patches/Seeds|main=yes}} ==Payment item alternative locations== {| class="wikitable sortable" !Payment Item !Locations |- |{{plinkp|Compost}}
[[Compost]] |Buy from farming shops near vegetable patches or from farmers near farming patches. |- |{{plinkp|Empty sack}} {{plinkp|Potato}}
[[Potato]]es |North of [[Ardougne]], north-west of [[Lumbridge]], north-east of Lumbridge, [[Miscellania]], buy from [[Hudo]] in the [[Grand Tree]]. Also found in larder in a [[player-owned house]]. |- |{{plinkp|Empty sack}} {{plinkp|Onion}}
[[Onion]]s |Onion field in [[Rimmington]], small onion patch behind chicken coops north-west of [[Lumbridge]], [[Rellekka]], buy from [[Hudo]] in the [[Grand Tree]]. |- |{{plinkp|Empty sack}} {{plinkp|Cabbage}}
[[Cabbage]]s |Cabbage field near [[Falador]], field in [[Rimmington]], [[Edgeville Monastery]], north-west of [[Lumbridge]], [[Miscellania]], [[Rellekka]]. |- |{{plinkp|Apples(5)}} {{plinkp|Cooking apple}}
[[Cooking apple|Apples]] |3 spawns in [[Cooks' Guild]], one spawn in farming shop north of [[Ardougne]], buy from [[Culinaromancer's Chest|Food Chest]] in [[Lumbridge Castle]] after starting [[Recipe for Disaster]], [[Cobado's Groceries]] in [[Civitas illa Fortis]] sells 20, quickly respawning barrels of apples on the pirate ship to [[Lunar Isle]] ([[Lunar Diplomacy]]). |- |{{plinkp|Bananas(5)}} {{plinkp|Banana}}
[[Banana]]s |[[Banana plantation|Banana trees]] on [[Karamja]], right by [[amulet of glory]] teleport spot; buy from [[Trader Crewmember]] at [[charter ship|charter]] docks, [[Bones to Bananas]] spell. |- |{{plinkp|Oranges(5)}} {{plinkp|Orange}}
[[Orange]]s |Buy in the [[Grand Tree]] from [[Heckel Funch]] (20 in stock) or [[Hudo]] (10 in stock). |- |{{plinkp|Pineapple}}
[[Pineapple]]s |Pineapple plants on [[Karamja]], buy in the [[Grand Tree]] from [[Heckel Funch]] or [[Hudo]] - 10 in each store, [[Trader Crewmember]] at charter docks - 15 in each store, noted pineapples dropped by [[tortoise]]s at the Grand Tree and north of [[Tree Gnome Village (location)|Tree Gnome Village]], noted and un-noted pineapples dropped by [[kurask]] in either slayer dungeon. |- |{{plinkp|Tomatoes(5)}} {{plinkp|Tomato}}
[[Tomato]] |Various single spawns. Purchase in various food stores. Buy in the [[Grand Tree]] from [[Hudo]]. Buy from [[Culinaromancer's Chest|Food Chest]] in Lumbridge Castle after starting [[Recipe for Disaster]]. |} ==Acquiring seeds== The following are several ways to get the seeds needed for farming: *Most seeds can be bought from other players. *Picking a vegetable from one of the non-player-owned fields dotted around [[Gielinor]] occasionally provides a seed as well. *Pickpocketing [[farmer]]s with level 10 [[Thieving]], which will occasionally give [[potato seed]]s. *On populated worlds it is easy to get large amounts of lower level seeds from players training Thieving at a [[master farmer]] or completing [[farming contracts]] and dropping the lower level seeds. **An alternative for lower-level players who wish to acquire seeds but do not have the required Thieving levels to pickpocket from Martin the Master Gardener or from Olivia's stall is to simply stand around Draynor Marketplace near the stalls and wait for players to drop seeds they are pickpocketing. (Many players train Thieving here and end up dropping a lot of their seeds on the ground because they're either doing it only for experience, have no room in their inventories, or are simply not getting the seeds they want and drop the lower-level ones.) *Opening [[seed pack]]s given as [[farming contract]] rewards. *Pickpocketing [[Master Farmer]]s (including [[Martin the Master Gardener]]) with level 38 [[Thieving]] for all seeds except tree seeds and fruit tree seeds. *Buying from [[Olivia]] who runs the seed stall in [[Draynor Village]], or from [[Amelia's Seed Shop]] in the [[Farming Guild]]. Only low-level-farming seeds are available for purchase. *Stealing from [[Draynor Seed Market|Olivia's stall]] with level 27 [[Thieving]]. (You will not be able to purchase seeds from her for a short period of time if you steal from her.) *[[Bird nest]]s give tree and fruit tree seeds and can be obtained from the following ways: **random events in [[Woodcutting]]; **trading [[mole claw]]s and/or [[mole skin]]s with [[Wyson the gardener]] at [[Falador Park]]. [[Mole claw]]s and [[mole skin]]s can be obtained by killing the [[Giant Mole]] or killing [[Molanisk]]s with level 39 [[Slayer]] for [[mole claw]]s alone. **Doing [[Birdhouses|birdhouse runs]]. *[[Managing Miscellania]] for seeds and [[bird nest]]s. Allocating resources to cutting wood gives bird nests, allocating resources to herbs or flax can yield herb seeds, and allocating resources to farming gives a wide variety of seeds. The [[Throne of Miscellania]] quest is required (and [[Royal Trouble]] for the farming). *Monster drops. [[Ogre]]s, [[Moss giant]]s, [[Aberrant spectre]]s, and [[Dagannoth]]s are a few examples of monsters with good seed drops. *Catching [[impling]]s, especially [[Nature impling]]s. *Watermelon seeds can be obtained as a reward in the [[Temple Trekking]] minigame. *[[Seaweed spores]] spawn randomly in the [[underwater|Fossil Island underwater area]]. *[[Crystal bow]]s can be bought from [[Islwyn]] in [[Prifddinas]] for {{NoCoins|900000}} coins each, dismantled back to a [[crystal weapon seed]], and finally traded to [[Pennant]] in Prifddinas for a [[crystal acorn]]. ==See also== *[[Disease (Farming)|Disease]] *[[Farming training]] {{Seeds}}

{{Future Content}} [[File:The Blood Moon Rises - Overview (7).png|right|thumb|200px|Concept art of seeker arrow shafts from [[Update:The Blood Moon Rises - Overview]]]] '''Seeker arrows''' are an upgraded type of [[arrow]] that have +20 more accuracy and an increased minimum hit, compared to their regular counterparts. They will be released with [[The Blood Moon Rises]] quest, and will be created by adding [[bloodwood sap]] to [[arrows]] to upgrade them, or by adding the sap to [[logs]] or [[arrow shaft]]s before [[fletching]] them into arrows.
The exact way the mechanic would function was clarified in [[Update:Blood Moon Rises Rewards]], as follows: * Accuracy is rolled as normal. * If the accuracy roll fails, the hit is 0. * If the accuracy roll succeeds, damage is rolled normally. * If that damage is below 3, it is raised to 3.
==See also== * [[Update:The Blood Moon Rises - Overview]] * [[Update:Blood Moon Rises Rewards]]

revision.text:
{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Seercull |image = [[File:Seercull.png]] |release = [[7 November]] [[2005]] |update = Waterbirth Island - deeper, darker, deadlier! |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = An ancient Fremennik bow that was once used to battle the Moon Clan. |value = 8000 |weight = 1.360 |exchange = Yes |id = 6724 |leagueRegion = Fremennik }} [[File:Seercull detail.png|left|120px]] The '''seercull''' is a Fremennik bow that requires a [[Ranged]] level of 50 to wield, and fires arrows up to [[Amethyst arrow|Amethyst]]. Compared to a [[magic shortbow]], it has a slower rate of fire and a different [[special attack]] which is more effective against mages. In addition, its normal and rapid fire attacks have one more range than that of a [[shortbows|shortbow]], and its long range attack is equivalent to that of a [[comp bows|composite bow]]. It is a comparable weapon to the [[Magic comp bow]]. The name can be attributed to the combination of the word ''seer ''(another word for "mage" or "wizard") and the word ''cull ''(another word for "kill"), in other words, the ''mage-killer''. This is a fitting name because of the effect of its special attack and its examine text. {{clear|left}} ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = +69 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = 2h |speed = 5 |attackrange = 8 |combatstyle = Bow |image = [[File:Seercull equipped.png|150px]] |altimage = [[File:Seercull equipped female.png|150px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Bow|speed=5|attackrange=8}} ==Special attack== [[File:Soulshot.gif|thumb|280px|A player using the bow's special attack, ''Soulshot''.]] The Seercull has a [[special attack]], ''Soulshot'', which consumes 100% of the player's special attack energy. It is [[Successful hit|guaranteed to hit]] and lowers the opponent's [[Magic]] level equal to damage dealt. However, damage inflicted by ''Soulshot ''is only boosted strictly through ammunition and visible range level. Ranged [[prayer]]s (such as [[Eagle Eye]] and [[Rigour]]) and all other equipment providing ranged strength, including those with special effects such as any variants of [[Void Knight equipment]], [[salve amulet]], or [[Slayer helmet]], will all have no effect. The special attack will only drain the opponent's Magic level if it is not already reduced; consecutive use of ''Soulshot ''or [[accursed sceptre]] special attacks will have no effect on their Magic level until the stat has been fully restored, at which point it may be reapplied.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1282369216058982400|date=12 July 2020|quote=Same in PvP too, by the way, since I wasn't explicit earlier.|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/105845|archivedate=17 December 2020}} In PvP combat, the special attack gains use for its ability to lower the Magic level of a mage to prevent them from casting spells. However, this can be mitigated by use of [[super restore]] potions. The following formula can be used to calculate the max hit of ''Soulshot'':

\text{Maximum Hit} =\left\lfloor 0.5+\frac{\text{(Visible Ranged Level} + 10) *(\text{Ammo Ranged Strength} +64)}{640} \right\rfloor {{efn|name=stance|A stance bonus of 10 is used regardless of attack style used.}} {{notelist}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Seercull}} ==Comparison between other ranged weapons== {{Ranged weapons comparison}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Seercull}} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClueHeader}} {{EmoteClue|tier=elite|emote=Headbang|location=Outside the room with [[gargoyles]] on the [[Slayer Tower]]'s top floor|item1=Seercull|item2=combat bracelet|item3=helm of neitiznot}} {{EmoteClueBottom}} ==Trivia== *A character wearing [[spined armour]] and a seercull appears in the banner at the top of the ''Old School RuneScape'' [https://oldschool.runescape.com/ official website]. [[File:Official website banner logo.png|frame|left|The banner atop the official website featuring a seercull second from the right.]] {{Clear|left}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Ranged weapons}} {{Waterbirth Island}} [[Category:Defence reduction]] [[Category:Weapons with Special attacks]] [[Category:Collection log items]]

{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Organisation |name = Seers' Council |release = [[24 July]] [[2007]] |update = King's Ransom |leader = [[Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight]] |location = [[Seers' Village]] }} The '''Seers' Council''' run [[Seers' Village]], dealing with issues like crime and relocation. A named member of the council is [[Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight]], the leader of the Seers, yet the rest are only shown on the interface as [[Seer]]s.
Seers' Council is mentioned in the quest, [[King's Ransom]].
==Trivia== *Seers' Council is quite similar to a [[Wikipedia:City council|city council]], commonly used in cities in real life.

{{Infobox Location |name = Seers' Eye |image = [[File:Seers' Eye.png|300px]] |release = [[19 November]] [[2025]] |update = Sailing is OUT TODAY! |members = Yes |location = [[Kandarin]] |map = {{Ocean map|x=2710|y=3527|zoom=1}} |leagueRegion = No }} '''Seers' Eye''' is a small lake near [[Seers' Village]] and [[Sinclair Mansion]]. It connects to [[Merwick Lake]] and [[Vesmjos]] through a branching channel to the north.
It is one of three lakes fed by [[Vesmjos]].
It contains two [[salmon]] [[fishing spot]]s.
==Trivia== * In the [[March 2025 Sailing Alpha]], the area was named "Lake Sinclair", but it was renamed in the [[June 2025 Sailing Beta]].
