{{External|rsc|rs|dw}} {{Otheruses|the animal|the penguins in a sheep costume|Sheep (penguins)|other uses|Sheep (disambiguation)}} {{Infobox NPC |version1 = Dark grey |version2 = Grey |version3 = Light grey |version4 = Monastery |name = Sheep |image1 = [[File:Sheep (dark grey, 1).png|125px]][[File:Sheep (dark grey, 2).png|125px]][[File:Sheep (dark grey, sheared).png|125px]] |image2 = [[File:Sheep (grey, 1).png|125px]][[File:Sheep (grey, 2).png|125px]][[File:Sheep (grey, sheared).png|125px]] |image3 = [[File:Sheep (light grey, 1).png|125px]][[File:Sheep (light grey, 2).png|125px]][[File:Sheep (light grey, sheared).png|125px]] |image4 = [[File:Sheep (Monastery, 1).png|125px]][[File:Sheep (Monastery, 2).png|125px]][[File:Sheep (Monastery, sheared 1).png|125px]][[File:Sheep (Monastery, sheared 2).png|125px]] |release1 = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |release2 = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |release3 = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |release4 = [[5 December]] [[2006]] |update1 = Runescape beta is now online! |update2 = Runescape beta is now online! |update3 = Runescape beta is now online! |update4 = Treasure Trails, spiders and sheep |members = No |race = [[Sheep]] |location = Varies |examine1 = {{*}} White and fluffy.
{{*}} Freshly sheared. |examine2 = {{*}} White and fluffy.
{{*}} Freshly sheared. |examine3 = {{*}} White and fluffy.
{{*}} Freshly sheared. |examine4 = White and shaggy. |map = No |id1 = 1178,1301,1304,2693,2696,2699 |id2 = 1299,1302,1308,2694,2697,2786 |id3 = 1300,1303,1309,2695,2698,2787 |id4 = 2691,2692,2788,2789 |leagueRegion = Asgarnia,Karamja,Kandarin,Kourend,Misthalin,Tirannwn }} '''Sheep''' are mammals found throughout ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''. Players can use [[shears]] on most sheep to gain a piece of [[wool]], which they can make into a [[ball of wool]]. ==Variants== ===Shearable=== *'''Sheep''' (unsheared) - the most common variant. Choosing the "shear" option or using a pair of [[shears]] on the sheep will give the player 1 [[wool]], and the sheep will take on a thinner, less wooly appearance. After 50 [[tick]]s (30 seconds), their wool will be replenished. *[[Sheep (Zanaris)]] - Sheep found in [[Zanaris]] do not have a "shear" option, though they can still be sheared by using a pair of shears on them. Unlike Sheep in Gielinor, they will replenish their wool after 100 ticks (1 minute). ===Unshearable=== * '''Sheep''' (sheared) - a permanently sheared version of the sheep. Though they will occasionally perform the eating animation, their wool does not replenish, and they cannot be interacted with. These are only found in the pen south of [[Varrock]] or west of Lumbridge Castle. * [[Ram]] - a male sheep which cannot be sheared, but is attackable. * [[Li'l lamb]] - a young sheep which cannot be interacted with. * [[Lamb]] - a young sheep which cannot be interacted with. * [[Sheep (penguins)]] - a pair of penguins disguised as sheep, found in Fred the Farmer's pen and referred to by Fred as "The Thing". They serve a role in the [[Cold War]] quest. * [[Sick-looking sheep]] - several multi-coloured sheep found around [[Ardougne]]. They serve a role in the [[Sheep Herder]] and [[Mourning's End Part I]] quests. * [[Sheep (Castle Wars)]] - a cosmetic transformation taken on by the player, which occurs in the [[Castle Wars]] waiting rooms under certain circumstances. ==Locations== ===Free areas=== *[[Lumbridge]] - [[Fred the Farmer]]'s pen north of the [[Lumbridge General Store]] contains 16 shearable sheep, the most which can be found in any one area of the game. They are also relatively close to the [[Spinning wheel]] and bank in [[Lumbridge Castle]] - it takes approximately 3 minutes to shear 27 sheep, spin the wool into balls, bank them, and return to the pen. *[[Varrock]] - a pen south of the [[Stone circle]] contains 5 shearable sheep (there are another 5 which are permanently sheared). *[[Falador]] - there are 7 sheep by the [[Make-over mage]]'s house, just outside the walls to the south-west. [[Members]] who can use the Falador [[agility shortcut]] have easy access to the city's west bank from here. *[[Edgeville Monastery]] - there are 3 sheep north of the Monastery west of [[Edgeville]]. These have a slightly different appearance most to other sheep, but can be sheared in the same way. ===Member areas=== *[[Hosidius]] - there are 12 sheep in the back of [[Watson's house]], with a spinning wheel inside. There are also 2 sheep in a small farm to the north of the [[Hosidius]] [[estate agent]]. *[[East Ardougne]] - [[Richard (Ardougne)|Richard]]'s pen north of the city contains 10 sheep. Sick sheep outside the pen cannot be sheared. *[[Fisher Realm]] - there are 10 sheep in a pen just south of the fairy ring. Access requires completion of [[Holy Grail]]. *[[Zanaris]] - there are 5 sheep wandering around the [[Fairy rings|Fairy ring]]. [[Sheep (Zanaris)|Zanaris sheep]] do not have a left-click "shear" option, but can still be sheared for wool by using a pair of shears on them. Access requires starting [[Lost City]]. *[[Lletya]] - there are 3 sheep in the north-west corner, relatively close to the south-eastern bank. Access requires starting [[Mourning's End Part I]]. {{LocTableHead}} {{LocLine |name = Sheep |location = South of [[Varrock]] |levels = N/A |members = No |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 Attack them at thy peril.|letter=Letter 28}} In one such letter, he says: 'I respect the sheep, for their purpose is essential, albeit secret. Some day the rest of you mortals might discover the true power of the sheep, innocent in appearance but essential in bearing, and realise why they shelter under my protection for the time being.'{{CiteGodLetter|issue=13|letter=Letter 8}} **In addition to Guthix's expressing his patronage over sheep in the god letters, it is stated that [[Zamorak]] hates the creatures immensely.{{CiteGodLetter|issue=15|letter=Letter 11}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Sheep Shearer}} {{2021 Easter event}}

{{External|rs=Sheep}} {{Infobox NPC |version1 = Grey |version2 = Light-grey |version3 = Sheared |version4 = Unused |name = Sheep |image1 = [[File:Sheep (Zanaris, grey).png|200px]] |image2 = [[File:Sheep (Zanaris, light-grey).png|200px]] |image3 = [[File:Sheep (Zanaris, sheared).png|200px]] |image4 = [[File:Sheep (Zanaris, unused sheared).png|200px]] |release = [[27 February]] [[2006]] |update = A Fairy Tale Part I - Growing Pains |members = Yes |race = [[Sheep]] |location = [[Zanaris]] |options = Talk-to |examine1 = White and fluffy. |examine2 = White and fluffy. |examine3 = Freshly sheared. |examine4 = Freshly sheared. |map1 = {{Map|2415,4451|2416,4435|2423,4432|plane=0|mapID=-1|mtype=pin}} |map2 = {{Map|2410,4456|2415,4429|plane=0|mapID=-1|mtype=pin}} |map3 = No |map4 = No |id1 = 5843 |id2 = 5844 |id3 = 5845 |id4 = 5846 |leagueRegion = Misthalin }} {{Synced switch|version1=[[File:Sheep (Zanaris, grey) chathead.png|left]]|version2=[[File:Sheep (Zanaris, light-grey) chathead.png|left]]|version3=[[File:Sheep (Zanaris, grey) chathead.png|left]]|version4=[[File:Sheep (Zanaris, light-grey) chathead.png|left]]}} '''Sheep''' are talking animals located in [[Zanaris]] west of the wheat field. The sheep can be sheared. Unlike sheep found in Gielinor, there is a chance to fail when shearing these sheep, resulting in the message: {{mes|The sheep manages to get away from you!}} When spoken to, the sheep is revealed to be a poet, and suggests if the player would like to hear one of their latest creations. If agreed to, the sheep will recite one of four compositions. ==Dialogue== {{Hastranscript|npc}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 5 December 2006 |update = Treasure Trails, spiders and sheep |change = The NPC was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== Normal= {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Sheep (Zanaris) (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Sheep (Zanaris, grey).png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Sheep (Zanaris) chathead (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Sheep (Zanaris, grey) chathead.png|center]] |- |27 February 2006 –
5 December 2006 |5 December 2006 –
present |} |-| Sheared= {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Sheep (Zanaris, shorn) (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Sheep (Zanaris, sheared).png|center|300x150px]] |- |27 February 2006 –
5 December 2006 |5 December 2006 –
present |} ==Trivia== *Despite a model existing for the light-grey sheared sheep, when the light-grey sheep is sheared ingame, it becomes a dark-grey sheared sheep. *The last of these four poems almost exactly replicates the first stanza of Lewis Carrol's [https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Jabberwocky Jabberwocky]. However, there are a few differences in the way some of the words are spelled, rendering "toves" in the original for example as "toathes", and "borogroves" as "borrowgroves". *An additional poem by the Zanaris sheep was published in an edition of the [[Postbag from the Hedge]], as a response to the question how its species had obtained the faculty of speech. It ends with the lines: "I'm sure you'd agree, given the choice / Eaten for food, or given a voice?"{{CitePostbag|issue=5|author=Sheep|letter=Letter 8}} *When a light-grey sheep provides dialogue that involves the cow, its chat head will use the grey sheep's model for its responses. ==References== {{reflist}} {{Zanaris}}

{{Cache}} {{Infobox NPC |name = Sherpa |image = [[File:Sherpa (RuneScape 2 Beta).png|250x250px]] |release = [[1 December]] [[2003]] |update = RuneScape 2 Beta is Here! |removal = January-March 2004 |removalupdate = |members = |race = [[Human]] |quest = [[Death Plateau]] |location = |gender = Male |options = Talk-to |examine = A sherpa. |map = No |id = beta719 |leagueRegion = No }} [[File:Sherpa (RuneScape 2 Beta) chathead.png|left]] The '''sherpa''' was an unused non-player character present in the ''RuneScape 2'' beta. He would have appeared in the original version of [[Death Plateau]]. Presumably players would have been directed to speak to him by the [[Hermit (RuneScape 2 Beta)|hermit]]. After helping him, he would give the player the [[Secret way map (RuneScape 2 Beta)|secret way map]], which alongside the [[Combination scroll (RuneScape 2 Beta)|combination scroll]] would have been given to [[Marius (RuneScape 2 Beta)|Marius]] to complete the quest.
The NPC was deleted before the end of the beta. In the final version of Death Plateau released in August 2004, he was superseded by [[Tenzing]].

{{Infobox Scenery |version1 = Black |version2 = Orange |version3 = Blue |version4 = Red |version5 = Green |version6 = Yellow |version7 = Light blue |version8 = Pink |name = Shield |image1 = [[File:Shield (Clan Hall, black).png|250x250px]] |image2 = [[File:Shield (Clan Hall, orange).png|250x250px]] |image3 = [[File:Shield (Clan Hall, blue).png|250x250px]] |image4 = [[File:Shield (Clan Hall, red).png|250x250px]] |image5 = [[File:Shield (Clan Hall, green).png|250x250px]] |image6 = [[File:Shield (Clan Hall, yellow).png|250x250px]] |image7 = [[File:Shield (Clan Hall, lightblue).png|250x250px]] |image8 = [[File:Shield (Clan Hall, pink).png|250x250px]] |release = [[26 May]] [[2021]] |update = Clans Soft Launch |members = Yes |quest = No |location = [[Clan Hall]] |options = None |examine = A decorated shield. |map = {{Map|x:1754,y:5462|x:1765,y:5462|plane=1|mapID=-1|mtype=pin}} |id1 = 41713 |id2 = 41714 |id3 = 41715 |id4 = 41716 |id5 = 41717 |id6 = 41718 |id7 = 41719 |id8 = 41720 }} '''Shields''' are [[scenery]] objects that can be found in the [[Clan Hall]]. The colour of the shield corresponds to the clan colour, and as such, only one of the colours can be seen in each Clan Hall. Players cannot interact with these shields, but they can [[examine]] them.
{{Clans}}

{{Infobox Scenery |version1 = 1 |version2 = 2 |name = Shield |image1 = [[File:Shield (Defender of Varrock, 1).png|250x250px]] |image2 = [[File:Shield (Defender of Varrock, 2).png|250x250px]] |release = [[21 February]] [[2024]] |update = Defender of Varrock |members = Yes |quest = [[Defender of Varrock]] |location = [[Varrock Castle]] |options = None |examine = It's been knocked off the wall. |map = No |id1 = 50124 |id2 = 50125 }} '''Shields''' can be found inside [[Varrock Castle]] during [[Defender of Varrock]] whilst the castle is under siege by [[Zemouregal]] and his army of [[Armoured zombie]]s. The shields can be examined but have no other interaction options.
{{Defender of Varrock}}

{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Scenery |name = Shield Display |image = [[File:Shield Display.png|250x250px]] |release = [[22 November]] [[2005]] |update = Making History and minor changes |members = Yes |quest = [[Making History]] |location = [[Outpost]] |options = Study |examine = A battle-weathered shield. |map = {{Map|x:2437,y:3344|plane=0|mapID=0|mtype=pin}} |id = 10267 }}
The '''Shield Display''' is located in the [[Outpost]] museum after the completion of the [[Making History]] quest. The shield inside the display appears to be a [[Fremennik shield]]. Studying the case results in the message: "Inside the case is a giant shield, the plate reads: 'This shield comes from the Fourth age when people were fighting to become more settled and less nomadic'."

{{Infobox Scenery |version1 = Shield and Axe |version2 = Shelves |name = Shield display |image1 = [[File:Shield display (Jatizso, shield and axe).png|250x250px]] |image2 = [[File:Shield display (Jatizso, shelves).png|250x250px]] |release = [[6 February]] [[2007]] |update = Fremennik Isles |members = Yes |quest = No |location = [[Jatizso]] |options = None |examine = A shield display. |map1 = {{Map|x:2393,y:3794|plane=0|mapID=-1|mtype=pin|group=1}} |map2 = {{Map|x:2396,y:3799|x:2402,y:3797|plane=0|mapID=-1|mtype=pin|group=2}} |id1 = 21445 |id2 = 21446 }} '''Shield displays''' are [[scenery]] objects found on the island of [[Jatizso]]. Players cannot interact with the shield displays, but they can [[examine]] them.
{{Jatizso}}

revision.text:
{{External|rs|rsc=Half Dragon Square Shield (left)}} {{Otheruses|the rare drop|the quest item|Broken shield}} {{Infobox Item |name = Shield left half |image = [[File:Shield left half.png]] |release = [[20 August]] [[2003]] |update = New - Legends Quest! |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = The left half of a dragon square shield. |value = 110000 |weight = 2.721 |exchange = Yes |id = 2366 |leagueRegion = Misthalin,Desert,Tirannwn,Kourend }} [[File:Shield left half detail.png|left|120px]] The '''shield left half''' is an item that can be joined with the [[Shield right half|right half]] to create the [[Dragon sq shield|dragon square shield]] with level 60 [[Smithing]]. Joining the right half with the left half nets 75 Smithing experience. The other half of the shield is sold by [[Siegfried Erkle]] in the [[Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items]] for 750,000 coins. This item is a rare drop from the [[rare drop table]]. Wearing a [[ring of wealth]] will increase the chances of receiving one from the rare drop table. [[Gorak]]s fought in the [[Gorak Plane]] are likely droppers of the shield left half, with a drop rate of 1/243.75 (with a ring of wealth equipped) if [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen]] and [[Legends' Quest]] have been completed.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/819512542754119680|date=12 January 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/103187|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=At most quest states I think it'd be around 1/250.}}{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/843817349027430407|date=20 March 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/107539|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=If you've done Legends' Quest, yes.}} [[Skotizo]] is the monster most likely to drop the shield left half, with a drop rate of 1/100, and is the only monster to have it on its standard drop table. The [[intricate pouch]] from [[Guardians of the Rift]] has a chance to contain the shield left half, as well as other dragon items. Creating a [[Dragon sq shield|dragon square shield]] from the two halves in [[West Ardougne]] is a hard task in the [[Ardougne Diary]]. ==Products== {{Uses material list|Shield left half}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Shield left half}} In addition to the sources in the above table, a Shield left half can be obtained as a drop from the [[Rare drop table]], accessible by most Slayer monsters. [[Gorak|Goraks]] also drop Shield left halves at a 1/244 chance with a [[ring of wealth]] equipped. ==Changes== ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Shield left half detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Shield left half detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Shield left half (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Shield left half.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
Beta |29 March 2004 –
present |} ==Trivia== *During the RuneScape 2 beta, the shield left half was erroneously sold in the [[Legends' Guild]] instead of the right half. This was fixed in [[Update:RS2 Music player and fixes|an update]] on [[15 March]] [[2004]]. *Although the shield halves become a square shield when joined, the right and left halves themselves appear to be two parts of a kiteshield. This has remained unchanged, even after the addition of an actual [[dragon kiteshield]] in [[2018]]. [[File:Dropped shield halves.png|100px|left|Both shield halves on the floor form the kiteshield.]] {{Clear|left}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Dragon equipment}} [[Category:Smithing]] [[Category:Collection log items]]

{{External|rs|rsc}} {{Has quick guide}} {{Otheruses|the quest|the shield itself|Shield of arrav (item)|the book about the shield|Book (Shield of Arrav)}} {{Infobox Quest |name = Shield of Arrav |number = 6 |image = [[File:Shield of Arrav.png|300px]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |series = None |developer = [[Paul Gower]] }} '''Shield of Arrav''' is a quest where the shield of the famous [[Arrav]] of [[Avarrocka]] has been stolen by organised crime syndicates in Varrock. ==Details== {{Quest details |start = [[Varrock]] Palace library. Talk to [[Reldo]], the librarian, located at the northern end of [[Varrock Castle]]. |startmap = 3209,3495 |difficulty = Novice |description = Varrockian literature tells of a valuable shield, stolen long ago from the museum of [[Varrock]], by a gang of professional thieves. See if you can track down this shield and return it to the museum. You will need a friend to help you complete this quest. |length = Short |requirements = A trustworthy friend or partner. Players can join the official [[chat-channel]] "OSRS SOA" to look for a partner. |items = *Phoenix Gang: 20 [[coins]] *Black Arm Gang: 2 [[Phoenix crossbow]]s (obtained during the quest) |recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|10|link=yes}} |kills = *Black Arm Gang: [[Weaponsmaster]] ''(level 23)'' *Phoenix Gang: [[Jonny the Beard]] ''(level 2)'' |leagueRegion = Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Asgarnia}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest }} ==Walkthrough== ===Choosing your gang=== [[File:Reldo chathead.png|left]] Talk to [[Reldo]] in the [[Varrock Palace library]], the northernmost room on the ground floor. Ask him for a quest, and he will suggest you look around for a book called the Shield of Arrav, which may have a quest for you. To find it, search the [[bookcase (Shield of Arrav)|bookcase]] with a blue and white book in the top shelf, located on the east side of the short bookcases in the middle of the room. Read the book, then speak with Reldo again to tell him you have read it. The player will ask him about the whereabouts of the [[Phoenix Gang]] and the [[Black Arm Gang]]. At this stage, you can choose to join either gang. If you wish to join the Phoenix Gang, speak to Baraek, the fur trader in the market. Otherwise, talk to [[Charlie the Tramp]] next to the southern gate of Varrock. '''Note''': You will only need to follow the steps to join one of the two gangs. It is recommended to '''make sure you have a partner from the opposite gang''' before choosing one. To find one, you may ask in the official [[chat-channel]] ''OSRS SOA''. {{Colour|red|Warning:}} Although the majority of players in the chat-channel offer their services for free, some players also charge [[coins|in-game money]]. Beware of the possibility of being [[scams|scammed]] when engaging in [[scams#Trust trading scams|trust trades]] with other players. When picking your gang, there are a number of considerations: *It is much easier to find Phoenix Gang members via the official chat-channel. *Phoenix Gang is recommended for lower combat levels. *Black Arm Gang is recommended if you do not want to gain combat experience. *If your partner has previously combined the two half pieces to create the complete certificate or has completed the quest, they cannot obtain the half piece of the shield from their gang hideout - which means certificates cannot be obtained from them. If your partner is from Phoenix Gang, they can help you acquire the key to the weapon store only. *The half shield of arrav reappears in their respective locations if the half certificate is lost, allowing players to repeatedly offer half certificates as long as they have not completed the quest. ===Finishing up=== {{Needed|[[Broken shield]]}} Take your half of the shield to [[Curator Haig Halen]], located in the [[Varrock Museum]]. He will take your half of the shield and give you two copies of [[Half certificate|half the certificate]]. Your partner, who has the other half of the Shield, will receive the other half of the certificate. Trade one half of the certificate with your partner for the other half. When you have both certificate halves, use them on the other to obtain a completed [[Certificate (Shield of Arrav)|certificate]]. If completing the quest as an [[Ironman]] you must 'use' the key/certificate on each other. [[File:Shield of Arrav - Certificate.png|centre]] Take the certificate to [[King Roald]] in [[Varrock Palace]] to receive your reward. Congratulations, quest complete! ==Rewards== {{Quest rewards |name = Shield of Arrav |image = [[File:Shield of Arrav reward scroll.png|centre]] |qp = 1 |rewards = *600 [[coins]] *Ability to claim 5 [[Kudos]] and an [[Antique lamp (Varrock Museum)#Shield of Arrav|Antique lamp]] rewarding 1,000 XP in any skill of at least level 20 from [[Historian Minas]] after completion of the quest (members only) }} ==Required for completing== Completion of Shield of Arrav is required for the following: * [[Heroes' Quest]] * [[Defender of Varrock]] * [[Ethically Acquired Antiquities]] ==Transcript== {{Hastranscript|quest}} ==Notes== *If a player cannot find someone to trade the certificates with, they cannot finish the quest. *Join the osrs soa friend chat. *A Black Arm Gang member can enter the Phoenix Gang Weapon Storage with a key from a Phoenix Gang member. *Phoenix crossbows can be obtained by Phoenix gang members either by going into the weapon store and telekinetic grabbing them, or by killing the [[weaponsmaster]] and picking up the two crossbows. However, the crossbows must be traded to a Black Arm gang member in order to gain trust to Katrine. *If collecting crossbows, they can respawn three times before the [[weaponsmaster]] does. *Additional certificate halves can be obtained by speaking to the curator provided the player has turned in a shield half prior and has not finished the quest nor in possession of a full certificate. The halves received will be the same as the one's received before. There is no practical limit to how many certificate halves you can have. '''Note: Once you finish the quest, or are in possession of a full certificate, you can no longer get spare shields or speak to the curator for additional certificate halves.''' However, you can continue to keep certificate halves in your bank account indefinitely after you have completed the quest or trade for them with other players. *New player trade restrictions apply to quest items, but it is still possible to trade the items by using them on the other player. *The player who joined the Phoenix Gang will receive 2 left halves, and the player who joined the Black Arm Gang will receive 2 right halves. *You can get multiple certificate halves by talking to [[Curator Haig Halen]]. ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 6 November 2024 |update = The Curse of Arrav & Mobile Anniversary Update |change = Changes were made to the quest with the release of [[The Curse of Arrav]], including but not limited to: * Updated dialogue * Jonny the Beard is now only attackable when tasked by Straven with doing so, and permanently disappears after the quest for those who killed him. }} {{Subject changes |date = 29 May 2007 |update = Varrock's New Look |change = The quest was updated with the redesign of Varrock. Before this update, to finish the quest, one of the players would need to give their partner their half of the shield. The person with both halves would then hand them in to the Curator, and get two certificates in return. They would then have to give one of the two certificates to the partner to finish the quest.
After this update, a system that mitigates any element of trust was implemented, where shield halves can be handed in for certificate halves, which can then be exchanged in a single trade. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== *Shield of Arrav was one of the 6 quests available during ''RuneScape Classic''{{'}}s launch. *Once a player finishes the quest, they can no longer take any halves of the shield from their storage places. However, players can still acquire the halves of the shield from other players (via trading, drops, or general stores). *In the beginning, a bug allowed the player to join both gangs. Katrine would appear angry at the player, but the player would still be able to enter the Black Arm Gang. The Phoenix gang doorman would also attack the player. *In the early days, entering the Phoenix Gang's headquarters required a separate key. This was later changed, and the key was removed from the game. *The shield is currently on display (display number 24) at the [[Varrock museum|Varrock Museum]] after you speak to the curator on the second floor and tell him how you recovered the shield for the museum. *Before the shield is put onto display in the [[Varrock museum|Varrock Museum]], it mentions "King Roald has offered a 1,200 coins bounty for the reward of the shield and we keep this display case empty in the hopes it will one day be returned." However, King Roald rewards the adventurer only 600 coins for quest completion - half of the advertised offer from the display case. This is because the bounty was split with the other player. *Although it's possible to start the quest with a complete certificate, attempting to turn it in to King Roald yields him saying, "The name on this certificate isn't yours! I can't give you the reward unless you do the quest yourself!" {{Shield of Arrav}}

===Black Arm Gang=== {{Needed|recommended=Food and a weapon to kill a combat level 23}} [[File:Charlie the Tramp chathead.png|left]] {{Map|3196,3388|3196,3382|3182,3382|3182,3399|3190,3399|3190,3388|3196,3388|mtype=polygon|caption=The entrance to the [[Black Arm Gang Headquarters]].|align=right|width=250|height=250}} To join the [[Black Arm Gang]], talk to [[Charlie the Tramp]] located just north of the south entrance of [[Varrock]]. Tell him you are looking for the Black Arm Gang, and he'll hint that their [[Black Arm Gang Headquarters|headquarters]] is down the alleyway. Enter the building to the south-west, then talk to [[Katrine]].
Tell her you've heard about the gang and that you won't give your source. Ask her if you can join and if she'll give you a try, and she will ask you to steal two crossbows from the [[Phoenix Gang]].
To steal the crossbows, you will need the [[weapon store key]], obtained by your partner in the Phoenix Gang section of the quest, after they have successfully joined the gang.
Once you have the key, head towards the Phoenix Gang's hideout, located east of the southern entrance to [[Varrock]]. Directly south of the rune shop and attached to the chapel is a small room with a ladder inside. Climb it and you will enter a room with the crossbows. If you try to take them, the [[Weaponsmaster]] will prevent you and attack - you will have to kill him first.
'''Note''': Another player with a second [[weapon store key]] may kill the weaponsmaster for you if you are low level or do not wish to gain combat experience. Your Phoenix Gang partner can obtain two keys with the [[drop trick]] when talking to [[Straven]], so that you may both enter.
Once he is dead, take two [[Phoenix crossbow]]s. Return to Katrine and she will make you a member of the Black Arm Gang. Go upstairs in the hideout and look for a [[cupboard (Shield of Arrav)|cupboard]], which contains the right half of the [[Broken shield|Shield of Arrav]].
<noinclude> [[Category:Shield of Arrav]] </noinclude>

===Phoenix Gang=== {{Needed|20 [[coins]]|recommended=a weapon to kill a combat level 2}} [[File:Baraek chathead.png|left]] To join the [[Phoenix Gang]], talk to [[Baraek]] in the centre of [[Varrock]], whose fur stall is marked with an icon of bear fur. Ask him where you can find the Phoenix Gang, and he will ask for 20 [[coins]] before telling you. After giving him the coins, he will direct you to the southern gates of the city, down the alleyway past the [[Blue Moon Inn]]. Head there and look for a red exclamation mark (on your map) just past the inn to find the [[Phoenix Gang Hideout|hideout]]. Enter the room to the south with a ladder inside, and climb down. {{Map|3243,3382|r=2|mtype=square|caption=The entrance to the [[Phoenix Gang Hideout]].|align=right|width=250|height=250}}
Inside the hideout, talk to [[Straven]]. Tell him you know who he is, then offer your services. He suggests that the Phoenix Gang would be very pleased if a Black Arm Gang contact called Jonny the Beard were to have an accident.
Exit the hideout and head to the [[Blue Moon Inn]] to the immediate west. Kill [[Jonny the Beard]] inside the inn.
'''Note:''' Jonny will not drop the report if killed with a [[ring of recoil]].
Jonny will drop a [[Intel report|report]]. Pick it up and bring it back to Straven. He will welcome you to the Phoenix Gang and hand you the [[Weapon store key]], which you need to save for your partner.
You can now enter the rest of the hideout; the thieves walking around are not aggressive to any players, but will retaliate if you attack them. Look around for a chest in the south-west corner of the hideout to find one half of the [[Broken shield|Shield of Arrav]]. You can only grab one shield half at a time, and you cannot obtain it after completing the quest. <noinclude>[[Category:Shield of Arrav]]</noinclude>

revision.text: ===Black Arm Gang=== {{Checklist| *Talk to [[Charlie the Tramp]] located near the south entrance of [[Varrock]]. {{Chat option|5Is there anything down this alleyway?|2Do you think they would let me join?}} *Go down the alley (the door to the west) and enter the [[Black Arm Gang]] headquarters. *Talk to [[Katrine]]. {{Chat option|1I've heard you're the Black Arm Gang.|1I'd rather not reveal my sources.|1I want to become a member of your gang.|1Well, you can give me a try can't you?|1Ok, no problem.}} *Trade your partner for a [[weapon store key]]. *Go to the south-east corner of Varrock and look for a small room with a ladder. It's connected to the west side of the building with the Chaos Altar in it. *Use the key on the door and climb up the ladder. *Kill the [[Weaponsmaster]], or use [[Telekinetic Grab]] to pick up two [[Phoenix crossbow]]s without fighting him. *Pick up both [[Phoenix crossbow]]s. *Take two [[Phoenix crossbow]]s to Katrine. '''You are now a member of the Black Arm Gang.''' *Go upstairs in the headquarters and open the [[cupboard (Shield of Arrav)|cupboard]] to the south of the stairs to find the right half of the [[broken shield#Right|Shield of Arrav]]. }} <noinclude>[[Category:Shield of Arrav]]</noinclude>

{{External|rs|rsc=Half Dragon Square Shield (right)}} {{Infobox Item |name = Shield right half |image = [[File:Shield right half.png]] |release = [[20 August]] [[2003]] |update = New - Legends Quest! |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = The right half of a dragon square shield. |value = 500000 |weight = 2.721 |exchange = Yes |id = 2368 |leagueRegion = Kandarin }}[[File:Shield right half detail.png|left|120px]] The '''shield right half''' is an item which can be bought in the [[Legends' Guild]] or the [[Myths' Guild]] for 750,000 [[coins]]. It can be combined with the [[shield left half]] (provided that you have 60 [[Smithing]]) to form the [[dragon square shield]]. A hammer and anvil is needed to combine the shield. Creating a [[Dragon sq shield|Dragon square shield]] from the two halves in West Ardougne is a hard task in the [[Ardougne Diary#Hard|Ardougne Diary]]. ==Products== {{Uses material list|Shield right half}} ==Shop locations== {{Store locations list|Shield right half}} ==Changes== ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Shield right half detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Shield right half detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Shield right half (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Shield right half.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
Beta |29 March 2004 –
present |} ==Trivia== *During the RuneScape 2 beta, the shield left half was erroneously sold in the [[Legends' Guild]] instead of the right half. This was fixed in [[Update:RS2 Music player and fixes|an update]] on [[15 March]] [[2004]]. *The right and left halves appear to be two parts of a kiteshield. [[File:Dropped shield halves.png|left|100px|Both shield halves on the floor form the kiteshield.]] {{Dragon equipment}}

revision.text:
'''Shield shops''' are a type of store throughout [[Gielinor]]. The stores are represented by a [[File:Shield shop icon.png]] icon. Shield shops sell [[square shield]]s and [[kiteshield]]s. There are three dedicated shield shops in ''Old School RuneScape''.
== Locations ==
=== Free-to-play ===
* [[Cassie's Shield Shop.]] in [[Falador]]. It sells [[wooden shield]]s, square shields from [[Bronze sq shield|bronze]] to [[mithril sq shield]]s, not including [[Black sq shield|black]] and [[white sq shield]], as well as kiteshields from [[Bronze kiteshield|bronze]] to [[steel kiteshield]]s.
=== Members ===
* [[Quality Armour Shop]] in [[Keldagrim]]. It sells [[steel sq shield]]s and [[black kiteshield]]s. * [[Shields of Mistrock]] in [[Mistrock]].
== Other shops that sell shields ==
=== Members ===
* [[Armour Shop (Jatizso)|Armour Shop]] in [[Jatizso]]. Officially a platebody shop, it also sells [[mithril sq shield]]s and [[mithril kiteshield]]s. * [[Armour store.]] in the [[Blast Furnace]] in [[Keldagrim]]. Officially an armour shop, it also sells square shields from [[Mithril sq shield|mithril]] to [[rune sq shield]]s, as well as kiteshields from [[Mithril kiteshield|mithril]] to [[rune kiteshield]]s. * [[Seddu's Adventurer's Store.]] in [[Nardah]]. Officially a platelegs shop, it also sells [[steel kiteshield]]s. * [[White Knight Armoury]] in [[White Knights' Castle]]. Officially a combat shop, it is the only shop to sell [[white sq shield]]s and [[white kiteshield]]s. Requires completion of the [[Wanted!]] quest to access and the player must have killed 300 [[Black knight|black knights]] for [[white sq shield]]s and 800 for [[white kiteshield]]s respectively. * [[Cam Torum Blacksmith]] located on the northern side of [[Cam Torum]]. It sells [[Square shield|square shields]] up to [[Adamant sq shield|adamant]], excluding black and white sq shields. * [[Elder Blunn's Spear and Shield Stall]] in [[The Summer Shore]]. Officially a [[weapon shop]], but also sells shields.
{{Shops}}
[[Category:Shops|*]]

revision.text:
{{external|rs=Shield|rsc}} {{Otheruses|shields used for defending|shields used as weapons|Shield (weapon)}} [[File:Wooden shield detail.png|thumb|150px|A [[wooden shield]], the first shield given to the player.]] There are several types of '''shields''' in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]'' but the most common are the metal [[square shield]] and [[kiteshield]]. Most require a certain [[Defence]] level to [[equip]].
Some shields can be made with the [[Smithing]] skill and some can be purchased or sold to the [[shield shop]] identified with a shield [[File:Shield shop icon.png]] [[icon]] on the [[map]].
==Square shield== {{Main|Square shield}} [[Square shield|Square shields]] (or sq shield) may be smithed in all metals and also found in black. It is weaker in all areas than the kiteshield, but has lower magic penalties. The [[Smithing]] level required is 8 above the base level for any metal, and the highest shield available in [[free-to-play]] region stores is the [[Iron sq shield]].
The [[anti-dragon shield]] also has the same shape as a "square" and is an excellent shield for the [[combat pure|pure]] mage, since it has no penalty to [[magic]] attack and a small amount of magic [[defence]], otherwise comparable to an [[iron sq shield]].
==Kiteshield== {{Main|Kiteshield}} [[Kiteshield|Kiteshields]] are better in all areas than a square shield, other than the magic penalty. Getting hold of a good kiteshield in [[free-to-play]] requires a high [[Smithing]] level, or trading with other players who are either [[members]] or accomplished smiths of high level. The Smithing level required is 12 above the base level for any metal, leading to a large gap in [[Experience]] required between the kiteshield and other items, like the [[Square shield]]. For example, the gap between being able to create the [[Mithril sq shield]] and [[Mithril kiteshield]] is around 109,000 experience (from level 58 to 62), which may not be worth it for some players, notably accounts in [[Ironman Mode]].
==Round shield== {{redirect3|Round shield|For the player-owned house decoration, see [[Round shield (Construction)]]}} Round shields are less common than other types of shields and cannot be made with [[metal]]s. The few that exist have similar [[combat stats]] to kiteshields.
===Wooden shields=== {{Main|Wooden shields}} [[Wooden shields]] are round shields made of various types of [[logs]] with the [[Fletching]] skill which can then be fletched into leather shields.
===Leather shields=== {{Main|Leather shield}} [[Leather shield|Leather shields]] are round shields created from using leather and nails with wooden shields.
===Other=== *[[Cabbage round shield]] *[[Defensive shield]] *[[Elemental shield]] *[[Falador shield 1]] *[[Fremennik shield]] *[[Granite shield]] *[[Malediction ward]] *[[Mind shield]] *[[Mirror shield]] *[[Neitiznot shield]] *[[Odium ward]] *[[Odium ward (or)]] *[[Toktz-ket-xil]] *[[Twisted buckler]] *[[Wooden shield]] *[[Wooden shield (g)]]
==Other shields== *[[Broodoo shield]] *[[Crystal shield]] *[[Spirit shields]] *[[Dragonfire shield]] *[[Dragonfire ward]] *[[Ancient wyvern shield]] *[[Dinh's bulwark]] (two-handed shield)
==Other items in shield slot== {{Main|Shield slot table}}
[[Category:Armour]] [[Category:Shields]]

{{External|rs|rsc=Shilo village}} {{otheruses|the quest|the village|Shilo Village (location)}} {{Has quick guide}} {{Infobox Quest |name = Shilo Village |number = 41 |image = [[File:Shilo Village.png|300px]] |release = [[27 January]] [[2003]] |update = Shilo Village Quest online |members = Yes |series = None |developer = Tytn H }} '''Shilo Village''' is a quest in which the player lays to rest a [[Rashiliyia|vengeful spirit]] that is attacking [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]], a town located in southern [[Karamja]]. The quest unlocks access to the village and its [[Shilo Village cart system|cart system]].
==Details== {{Quest details |start = Talk to [[Mosol Rei]] outside of [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]] in the south part of [[Karamja]]. |startmap = 2881,2951 |difficulty = Intermediate |description = A foul mist and a plague of undead have overtaken Shilo Village. Can you stop the queen of the dead and save the village? |length = Medium |requirements = * Completion of the following quests: ** [[Jungle Potion]] *** [[Druidic Ritual]] * {{SCP|Crafting|20|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} {{Questreqstart|no}} * {{SCP|Agility|32|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} {{Questreqstart|no}} * Must be able to defend from many [[Undead one]]s (level 61-73) and able to defeat three monsters that are about level 90. |items = * [[Spade]] (can be purchased at the [[Jiminua's Jungle Store|store]] north of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] for 4 [[coins]]) * A lit [[torch]] (bruma works), [[candle]] or [[black candle]] (an [[unlit torch]] and [[tinderbox]] can be purchased at the [[Jiminua's Jungle Store|store]] north of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] for a total of 7 [[coins]]) **'''you will not get this item back!''' **[[Lanterns]] or [[Firemaking cape]] don't work * [[Rope]] (can be purchased at the [[Jiminua's Jungle Store|store]] north of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] for 27 [[coins]]) * [[Bronze wire]] ** [[Bronze bar]] and [[hammer]] to create one (both can be purchased at the [[Jiminua's Jungle Store|store]] north of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] for a total of 13 [[coins]], there is an [[Anvil]] nearby) * [[Chisel]] (can be purchased at the [[Jiminua's Jungle Store|store]] north of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] for 1 [[coins]]) * 3 regular [[bones]] (obtainable during the quest) |recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|45|link=yes}} * Good [[food]] and [[armour]] or {{SCP|Prayer|43|link=yes}} for [[Protect from Melee]] (enough to make it through two long tunnels of level 73 monsters) * [[Weight-reducing clothing]] and [[Stamina potion|stamina]] or [[energy potion]]s *[[Antipoison]] if below {{SCP|Combat|65|link=yes}} for the [[tribesmen]] found around [[Karamja]] with [[poison]] that hits for '''11 each''' * [[Combat equipment]] to defeat [[Nazastarool]]'s three forms (all safespottable with [[Ranged]], [[Magic]] or a [[halberd]]) **{{SCP|Magic|13|link=yes}}+ to cast [[Fire spells]] (40% elemental weakness) or {{SCP|Magic|39|link=yes}} to cast [[Crumble Undead]] is recommended to kill him faster *Quick access to fairy rings and/or gnome glider is highly recommended - you may consider using a [[ring of dueling]] for quick access to a glider at [[Emir's Arena]], and the [[Ardougne cloak]] 1-4 for quick access to a [[fairy ring]] * Fast travel to several locations: **East of [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]] to start the quest - [[Gnome glider]], [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|ckr}}, [[Tai Bwo Wannai Teleport]] or [[Teleport to House]] (Brimhaven) **[[Tai Bwo Wannai]] (2 trips) - [[Tai Bwo Wannai Teleport]], [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|ckr}}, or [[Teleport to House]] (Brimhaven) **Eastern [[Karamja]] (2 trips) - [[Gnome glider]] or [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|dkp}} **[[Cairn Isle]] (2 trips) - [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|ckr}} or [[Tai Bwo Wannai Teleport]] (only useful for the second trip) |kills = * [[Nazastarool]] in 3 forms, levels 91, 68, and 93. (safespottable) |ironman = {{SCP|Smithing|4|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} (to make a [[bronze wire]]) |leagueRegion = <poem> Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Karamja}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest </poem> }}
==Walkthrough== {{Map|mtype=pin|width=650|caption=Map of the Quest |2885,2950,title:Start point,desc: |2923,3001,title:[[Ah Za Rhoon]],desc: |2763,2988,title:Tomb of Beverius,desc: |2921,3084,title:[[Rashiliyia's Tomb]],desc: |2809,3086,title:[[Trufitus]],desc: }} ===Beginning the quest=== [[File:Mosol Rei chathead.png|left|80px|frameless]] Ensure you have one free inventory space, then speak to [[Mosol Rei]] outside of Shilo Village, who tells you to run. ''Ask why'', and he will say [[Rashiliyia]] has returned. ''Ask who she is'', and he will explain she is the Queen of the dead that has brought a plague of undead upon the village. ''Ask what you can do'', and he will ask you to talk to the shaman [[Trufitus]] in [[Tai Bwo Wannai Village]] about something called the Legend of Rashiliyia, which may be to blame. ''Agree to go see the shaman'', then ''agree to take the [[Wampum belt]] to [[Trufitus]]''. {{Chat option|1Why do I need to run?|1Rashiliyia? Who is she?|1What can we do?|4I'll go to see the Shaman|2Yes, I'm sure and I'll take the Wampum belt to Trufitus.}} '''Ensure you have the belt in your inventory before continuing! The quest will not officially start until you give it to [[Trufitus]].'''
===The search for the temple of Ah Za Rhoon=== [[File:Trufitus chathead.png|left|frameless]] {{Map|x=2922|y=3000|r=4|mtype=square|width=220|height=220|align=right|caption=Location of Ah Za Rhoon}} {{Needed|[[Spade]], lit [[Torch]] or [[candle]], [[rope]], [[chisel]], 2 free inventory spaces| recommended=[[food]] and [[armour]] or [[Protect from Melee]] to run past level 61-73 [[undead one]]s}}
Head to [[Trufitus]] at the most north-eastern house in [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] and use the [[wampum belt]] on him. ''Ask about the legend'', and he will say that any information regarding it was lost in the vanished temple of [[Ah Za Rhoon]]. ''Ask if he knows anything more about the temple'', and he will mention that the priest Zadimus built the temple, and it is rumoured that Rashiliyia destroyed it after he rejected her affections. ''Ask him to tell you more'', then ''tell him you will search for Ah Za Rhoon'', and he will be skeptical but agree to help you if you are serious. ''Say you are serious about looking for Ah Za Rhoon'' and the quest will officially begin. {{Chat option|2Mosol Rei said something about a legend?|2Do you know anything more about the temple?|1Tell me more.|3I am going to search for Ah Za Rhoon!|1Yes, I will seriously look for Ah Za Rhoon and I'd appreciate your help.}}
The temple of [[Ah Za Rhoon]] is located on eastern [[Karamja]], south-west of the [[Shipyard (Karamja)|Shipyard]] and east of [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]] across the [[River Amja]] (the pile of rocks on the minimap). Use a [[gnome glider]] or [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|DKP}}, or walk there by crossing the [[a wooden log|wooden log]] to the east, then head south until you reach a mound of earth surrounded by rocks.
{{Checklist| *Use your [[spade]] on the [[Mound of earth|mound of earth]] to find a fissure. *Use your [[torch]] or [[candle]] on the fissure to light it up ('''this consumes the item!'''). *Add a [[rope]] to the fissure. *Search the fissure and climb down into the dungeon below ({{SCP|Agility|32}}). }}
:'''Note:''' The dirt mound may respawn if you take too long, but you may right click and search it twice to still enter (torch and rope not required).
In the cave are [[undead one]]s (level 61 - 73) who may attack you. Killing them occasionally causes a cloud of [[shilo mist]] to appear and deal damage to you.
In this cave system, you will need to find four items. Consult the following map to aid in finding them.
{| align=center |- |colspan=2 | [[File:Ah Za Rhoon map.png|center]] |- | '''1''' - Entrance || '''5''' - Waterfall rocks |- | '''2''' - Cave-in || '''6''' - Loose rocks |- | '''3''' - Smashed table || '''7''' - Sacks |- | '''4''' - Strange looking stone || '''8''' - Gallows |} [[File:Shilo Village - Boat ride.png|thumb|250px|Taking the boat out of [[Ah Za Rhoon]].]]
*Start off by heading south until you see the water. *Use a [[chisel]] on the [[strange looking stone]] (4 on the map; it is a small grey stone in the floor to the east of a [[Smashed chair]] and south of a stalagmite) to obtain the [[stone-plaque]]. *Go west past the column and search the [[Cave in]] (2 on the map) to crawl through and into some ruins. *Head north until you reach the end of the ruined buildings. Search the [[loose rocks]] (6 on the map) near the north-west wall to find the [[tattered scroll]]. If you fail, you will get hit for 4-7 (possibly more) damage. *Now head south-east until you come to a small dead-end branch. Search the sacks next to a smashed table (7 on the map) to obtain the [[crumpled scroll]]. *Finally, head north to the far end of the cavern, where you will find the ancient gallows (8 on the map). Search it and remove the corpse to obtain the [[Zadimus corpse]].
After acquiring all four items, you can teleport out. Otherwise, to exit the dungeon, return to the smashed table (3 on the map). You can craft the smashed table into a raft and use it to leave. This does not always work; it is possible to get the message that there isn't enough wood left. In this case, you will have to leave by other means. If you want, you can continue south, then east to the end of the cave. Search the rocks you find there to leave via the waterfall. You will take around 20 damage if you fall while leaving this way. You will find yourself near the stepping stones to the east of [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]].
===Tomb of Bervirius=== {{Needed|[[bronze wire]], A [[chisel]], 3 free inventory spaces|recommended=[[food]] for players with low agility|skills={{SCP|Agility|32}} {{Boostable|yes}} to enter the [[Tomb of Bervirius]]}} [[File:Shilo Village - Burying Zadimus corpse.png|thumb|250px|Zadimus' corpse is buried.]] [[File:Zadimus corpse detail.png|left|frameless|80px]] '''Read''' both the scrolls and the plaque, then use both scrolls, the plaque, and the corpse on [[Trufitus]]. He will tell you about the tomb of Bervirius and instruct you to bury the corpse.
West of the hut is the [[Tribal Statue]], bury the corpse there and the [[Spirit of Zadimus]] will appear, giving you a [[Bone shard (Shilo Village)|bone shard]] after some cryptic words. Use the bone shard on Trufitus, and tell him it appeared when you buried the corpse, that the spirit said something, and that it was about keys and kin. He'll tell you to look for [[Tomb of Bervirius|Bervirius' tomb]]. {{Chat option|1It appeared when I buried Zadimus' corpse|1He said something after he gave it to me.|1The spirit said something about keys and kin?}}
If you didn't bring [[bones]] with you, you can obtain the three required bones from the [[chicken]]s that spawn inside the village south of [[Trufitus]] now for a future section (beware of the poisonous [[tribesmen]]). [[File:Tomb of Bervirius map.png|left|thumb|200px|Map of the Tomb]] [[File:Tomb of Bervirius.png|right|thumb|250px|The Tomb of Bervirius.]]
Head towards [[Cairn Isle]] attached to the south-western coast of [[Karamja]] by either walking south or teleporting to a [[fairy ring]] and using code {{fairycode|ckr}}. Climb the rocks and cross the bridge to reach [[Cairn Isle]]. You may fall and take damage, keep trying until you succeed.
Search the well-stacked rocks (i.e. the cairn) on the north side of the island. Enter the crawl-way ({{SCP|Agility|32}}) to enter the [[Tomb of Bervirius]]. You may become stuck many times, but keep trying. Head south to the [[tomb dolmen (Tomb of Bervirius)|dolmen]], and search it to get a [[sword pommel]], a [[locating crystal]], and [[Bervirius notes]].
{{Color|Red|Warning:}} If you drop the sword pommel or the bone beads, they will turn to dust and you will have to go back and get new ones. If you drop the locating crystal, you will take 10 damage.
'''Note''': If you lose the [[Bervirius notes]], you will need [[charcoal]] and [[papyrus]] to get it again. You can purchase both from the [[Jiminua's Jungle Store|store]] north of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]].
'''Read''' the scrolls. You need to make a new necklace. Use a [[chisel]] on the sword pommel to make [[bone beads]]. Use the [[bronze wire]] on the beads to make the [[beads of the dead]] necklace.
You now need to head to eastern [[Karamja]]. If walking there, climb up the nearby rockslide to exit the tomb (you may fall and take up to 10 damage). Otherwise you may teleport out to use fairy ring {{fairycode|dkp}} or a [[gnome glider]].
===Tomb of Rashiliyia=== {{Needed|[[Chisel]], [[Bone shard (Shilo Village)|bone shard]], [[beads of the dead]] necklace, [[locating crystal]], 3 regular [[bones|bones.]]|recommended=Good [[food]] ([[lobsters]] or higher), [[weapon]], good [[armour]]. An emergency [[teleport]] for low level players|skills={{SCP|Crafting|20}} {{Boostable|yes}} to craft the [[bone key (Shilo Village)|bone key]]}} [[File:Rashiliyia's doors.png|100px|frameless|left]] [[File:Shilo Village - Tomb of Rashiliyia entrance.png|thumb|The hidden doors to the Tomb of Rashiliyia.]] [[Rashiliyia's Tomb]] is north of the crashed [[gnome glider]], accessible east of Trufitus across the log or south of fairy ring {{Fairycode|DKP}}. Look for a searchable [[palm tree (Shilo Village)|palm tree]]. Avoid the nearby [[The Shaikahan]] enemy which cannot be harmed. The entrance is hidden behind a hill and is most visible if you are facing south. Search the palm trees to find two [[carved doors|doors]]. Search these doors to find the shape of the keyhole, and then use your [[chisel]] on the [[Bone shard (Shilo Village)|bone shard]] to make a [[bone key (Shilo Village)|bone key]] ({{SCP|Crafting|20}}). '''Put on the [[beads of the dead]] necklace before entering or you will be unable to continue and will take constant damage!''' Use the key on the door to enter.
{|align=center |- |colspan=2 | [[File:Rashiliyia's Tomb map.png]] |- | '''1''' - Entrance || '''3''' - Skeleton door |- | '''2''' - Rock slope || '''4''' - Dolmen |}
Once inside, open the ancient gates, then climb down the rocks once you are ready to run past several aggressive [[undead ones]].
{{Color|red|Warning:}} In the next section you may be attacked by [[undead ones]] while trying to open the tomb doors by using your bones. The door will remember the amount of bones you have used, so if you die you can return and use the remaining bones.
Head west until you find a stack of coins ('''do not pick them up''' or more undead ones will be summoned), then south, and then south-west at the first fork. At the end of this corridor will be a set of [[tomb doors|doors]]. Other sets of dummy doors exist if you take a wrong turn, so make sure you're in the right place. '''Right-click''' the [[bones]] to use them on the door. '''While still wearing the necklace''', enter the room.
===Nazastarool=== [[File:Nazastarool safespot.png|thumb|220px|Lure Nazastarool to the northern part of the dolmen to safespot him.]] [[File:Rashiliyia chathead.png|left|frameless]] While still wearing the [[beads of the dead]], search the [[tomb dolmen (Rashiliyia's Tomb)|dolmen]] in the room. You will be attacked by [[Nazastarool]], a level 91 [[zombie]] that attacks with [[Melee]]. After you defeat him, he will turn into a level 68 [[skeleton]] and then a level 93 [[ghost]]. You can [[safespot]] all three forms by running around the dolmen after each form spawns until he gets stuck (see image). Each form has a 5 minute despawn timer. He has a weakness to [[Fire spells]] and [[Crumble Undead]], and is not resistant to any [[combat style]]. A [[salve amulet]] can be worn once the first form has spawned. A dwarf [[multicannon]] may be used.
'''Note:''' If you try to leave the cave the way you came in, the door will be locked and Rashiliyia will summon three [[Undead one|Undead ones]] to kill you. You can however still leave by using the bone key on the doors. If you leave and return, you won't need to fight the forms that you already defeated, and you won't need [[bones]] to open the tomb door.
'''Note:''' A friend may attack the boss for you, but you must be the last person to attack it to progress in the quest (0s count but not poison/venom).
Once you have defeated the ghost, you will get the [[Rashiliyia corpse|corpse of Rashiliyia]]. Teleport out towards [[Cairn Isle]] or leave from where you entered (using your key on the door).
[[File:Shilo Village - Rashiliyia laid to rest.png|thumb|left|220px|Rashiliyia is finally laid to rest.]]
Go back to the [[tomb of Bervirius]] on [[Cairn Isle]] west from [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]], and use [[Rashiliyia corpse|Rashiliyia's remains]] on the dolmen. [[Rashiliyia]] will appear before you. She will thank you for letting her rest in peace and give you your reward. {{Clear}}
==Rewards== {{Quest rewards |name = Shilo Village |image = [[File:Shilo Village reward scroll.png|centre]] |qp = 2 |rewards = *{{SCP|Crafting|3,875}} Crafting [[experience]] *Access to [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]] *Ability to quick travel to Shilo Village using the [[Shilo Village cart system|cart]] near the [[Brimhaven]] docks *After completing the quest, you can sell every item you obtained during the quest to [[Yanni Salika]] in Shilo Village for a total of {{Coins|2000}} — 100 each for the [[stone-plaque]], [[tattered scroll]], [[crumpled scroll]], [[Bervirius notes]], and the [[Bone key (Shilo Village)|bone key]]; 500 for the [[locating crystal]]; and 1000 for the [[beads of the dead]]. *Ability to charter the [[Lady of the Waves]] west to Shilo Village to [[Port Khazard]] or [[Port Sarim]] *[[Nazastarool]] accessible in the [[Nightmare Zone]]. }}
==Required for completing== Completion of Shilo Village is required for the following quests: *[[Recipe for Disaster]] - [[Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze|Freeing Sir Amik Varze]] *[[Legends' Quest]] *[[Lunar Diplomacy]] *[[One Small Favour]] Completion of Shilo Village is required for the following [[Achievement Diary|Achievement Diaries]]:
* [[Karamja Diary|Medium Karamja]] * [[Karamja Diary|Hard Karamja]]
==Transcript== {{hastranscript|Quest}}
==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 16 July 2020 |update = Ferox Enclave |change = Corrected a typo in the 'Shilo Village' quest. }} {{Subject changes |date = 2 June 2016 |update = The Woodcutting Guild |change = Fixed a typo in the Shilo Village quest. }} {{Subject changes footer}}
==Trivia== * Whilst the quest start icon is at Mosol Rei, and talking to him will change the text inside the journal, the quest is actually not marked as started in the quest list until you give the wampum belt to Trufitus and choose the correct dialogue options. *If you attempt to leave the Tomb of Rashiliyia through the entrance door your character will say:
::''Oh no, I'm going to be stuck in here forever!'' ::''How will I ever get out!'' ::''I'm too young to die!'' *If you search the fissure after adding the rope, but decline to enter, your character will say: ::''It looks very dangerous, and dark... Scary!''
* If you talk to Trufitus twice after completing the quest you get rid of the three pop-ups you get entering the village. {{Shilo Village}} {{Shilo Village (location)}}

{{External|rs|rsc}} {{otheruses|the city|the quest|Shilo Village}} {{Infobox Location |name = Shilo Village |image = [[File:Shilo Village (location).png|300px]] |release = [[27 January]] [[2003]] |update = Shilo Village Quest online |aka = Shilo |members = Yes |location = [[Karamja]] |race = [[Human]]s |teleport = [[Karamja gloves 3]] (to underground gem mine), [[Karamja gloves 4]] (to [[Duradel]]) |music = [[Ambient Jungle]] |map = {{Map|name=Shilo Village (location)|x=2849|y=2972|height=250|zoom=1}} |type = settlement |leagueRegion = Karamja }} {{Relative location |location = Shilo Village |north = Tai Bwo Wannai |west = Cairn Isle |south = Kharazi Jungle |east = Shipyard (Karamja){{!}}Karamja Shipyard }} '''Shilo Village''' is a small village in southern [[Karamja]], accessible after completing the [[Shilo Village]] [[Quest items|quest]].
==Transportation== Several transport options bring players into or close to Shilo Village, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:
* [[Hajedy]] and [[Vigroy]]'s [[Shilo Village cart system|cart system]] brings players between Shilo Village and [[Brimhaven]], costing between 10-200 coins each time.
* {{Plink|Karamja gloves 4}} — Duradel. Requires completion of the [[Karamja Diary|elite Karamja diary]]. * {{Plink|Karamja gloves 3}} — [[gem mine]]. Requires completion of the [[Karamja Diary|hard Karamja diary]]. * {{Plink|Achievement diary cape}} — west of the village. * {{Plink|Gnome glider|pic=Gnome goggles}} — east of the village. * {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|CKR}} — outside of the village. With 79 [[Agility]], players can scale the [[Rocks (Shilo Village)|rocks]] near the north-eastern corner of the village wall.
Players can also talk to [[Seravel]] upstairs in the Shilo Village fishing shop to buy a one-way [[Ship ticket|ticket]] on the [[Lady of the Waves]] for 25 coins. Players can then go to either [[Port Khazard]] or [[Port Sarim]] by presenting the ticket to the boat west of Shilo Village.
== History == {{LoreSources|Shilo Village (quest)|crumpled scroll|While Guthix Sleeps|One Small Favour|the2=yes}}
It is not known exactly when the village was first founded, but it presumably was created after the destruction of an ancient temple nearby, known as [[Ah Za Rhoon]]. The houses of those near the temple were entered by the witch queen [[Rashiliyia]], who killed the residents one by one. In the late [[Fifth Age]], the ghost of Rashiliyia returned from the dead and sent a horde of [[Undead one|undead ones]] to destroy Shilo Village. A brave [[Player character|adventurer]] managed to put her [[Rashiliyia corpse|remains]] within her son's tomb, releasing her spirit and thus ending her terrorizing spree.
Life continued after Rashiliyia's defeat. In a vote, resident Yanni Salika was voted the second most demanding person in Shilo Village, and later, after the events of [[While Guthix Sleeps]], the Slayer master [[Duradel]] was replaced by his daughter [[Kuradal]].
== Locations == [[File:Slayer Equipment (Shilo Village).png|thumb|[[Duradel]], a slayer master who resides in the village.]]
=== Buildings === {| class="wikitable" !Building !Description |- |[[Fernahei's Fishing Hut]] |Sells all normal [[Fishing#Equipment|fishing supplies]]. When [[Fishing#Fly fishing rods and feathers|fly fishing]], the shop can be used to top up on [[feather]]s. The [[Slayer masters]] [[Duradel]] and [[Kuradal]] are on the second floor, requiring {{SCP|Slayer|50|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Combat|100}} [[Combat level|combat]] to get [[Slayer task|tasks]] from. |- |Furnace hut |The [[furnace]] is directly across from the [[bank]], making it the closest furnace to a bank in the game. However, [[Yohnus]] charges 20 [[coins]] for each use. Players can put coins into his coffer to keep a full [[inventory]] of ore. After completing the elite [[Karamja Diary]], [[Yohnus]] will no longer charge the player to use the furnace. |- |[[Obli's General Store.|Obli's general store]] |Sells everything that a normal general store sells, and more, such as [[charcoal]] and [[papyrus]], used in the [[Legends' Quest]]. |- |[[Paramaya Inn]] |A large hostel and inn run by [[Kaleb Paramaya|Kaleb]] |- |[[Shilo Village bank]] |A [[bank]] that is very close to a furnace. |- |Yanni's house |Home of [[Yanni Salika]], who starts the [[One Small Favour]] quest. |} [[File:Shilo cart.png|thumb|The cart, a popular way of entering or leaving Shilo Village.]]
=== Skill training spots === The north-west corner of the village contains the [[Shilo Village mine]], a cluster of 7 [[gem rocks]]. An additional underground section of the gem mine, containing 48 more rocks and a [[bank deposit box]], is unlocked if the player has completed the Medium [[Karamja Diary]]. This area is popular among many players because here they can train both [[Mining]] and [[Crafting]] (by cutting gems) at the same time.
There are also four [[Fishing spots|fishing spot]]s in Shilo Village. At these fishing spots, [[fly fishing rod]]s and [[feather]]s can be used to lure [[Raw trout|trout]] and [[Raw salmon|salmon]], or [[fishing rod]]s and [[fishing bait]] can be used to catch [[Raw pike|pike]]. The [[Agility]] [[Stepping stone (Shilo Village)|shortcut]] across the village river can be used at 32 [[Agility]] to lowers the time needed to reach fishing spots on the other side of the river.
Finally, the [[undead one]]s over the gate can be safely attacked with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]], making it good for [[experience]]. [[Halberd]]s can also be used to train [[melee]].
=== Spawns === {| class="wikitable" |+ !Item !Spawns !Location |- |{{Plink|Seaweed}} |3 |Along the river |}
== Inhabitants ==
=== Personalities ===
* Two {{chatl|Banker (Shilo Village)|txt=bankers}}, who give players access to the [[Bank of Gielinor]]. * {{chatl|Duradel}}, the highest-level [[Slayer Master|Slayer master]]. * {{chatl|Fernahei}}, Owner of the [[Fernahei's Fishing Hut.|local fishing shop]]. * {{chatl|Kaleb Paramaya}}, the owner of the [[Paramaya Inn]], who sells [[Paramaya ticket|tickets]] and [[wine]]. * {{chatl|Kuradal}}, the daughter of Duradel, trained to one day take over for him. * {{chatl|Mosol Rei}}, a warrior from Shilo Village, who offers players entry for the first time. * {{chatl|Obli}}, owner of the [[Obli's General Store.|local general store]], which stocks more items than most other general stores in the game. * {{chatl|Seravel}}, a ticket salesman who offers tickets for the [[Lady of the Waves]]. * {{chatl|Vigroy}}, a cart driver who is experienced enough to bring players all the way to [[Brimhaven]]. * {{chatl|Yanni Salika}}, an antique collector who buys certain [[quest items]] from players. * {{chatl|Yohnus}}, a blacksmith who knows how convenient his furnace is and therefore charges players to use it.
=== Monsters === The only monsters found in Shilo Village are the [[Undead one|undead ones]], found right at its gates. There are five level 68 varieties and four level 73 varieties present.
==Quests==
* [[One Small Favour]] * [[Shilo Village]] * [[While Guthix Sleeps]]

{{External|rs}} '''Shilo mist''' can be found killing the [[zombie]] variant of [[undead one]]s on [[Karamja]]. All players within a square of the mist will receive 2-3 damage per hit. To avoid this, players need to be at least two squares away from where the mist spawns.
As the mist does not inflict recurring [[poison]], [[anti-poison potion]]s are not required.
==Historical== Shilo mist was also part of a former [[random event]] that occurred while [[Thieving]] from chests. Occasionally the chest would become stuck and mist would come out and damage nearby players. Despite the fact it had a green [[hitsplat]], however, the mist did not inflict recurring poison.
<gallery> Shilo mist.png|A poison gas cloud. Shilo mist animation.webp|The animation which appears several times when spawned. </gallery>
{{Discontinued random events}}
